# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2234%2E135344%2EqPOWgr)

Friend,
Today, the Trump administration unlawfully blocked thousands of federal programs across the board.
Although a judge has delayed that policy’s implementation, this move highlights the real harm that’s caused when our leaders ignore their oath to the Constitution to push through their policies.
This wasn’t just a bureaucratic decision for policy nerds to debate – it had an immediate effect in Michigan.
My office immediately started receiving an influx of questions from local leaders from both parties, facilities that care for veterans and nursing homes, university leaders, farmers, members of the armed forces, even cancer patients whose clinical trials were halted, all alarmed at the possibility that their programs and grants could be coming to a stop.
I respect that any administration gets to propose their vision for the federal budget. But every administration is also bound by the Constitution, which gives Congress—not the executive branch—the power to appropriate funds.
With so much on the line for real people, now is the time for each administration official to honor the oath they swore to uphold. Michiganders and people across the country are feeling the pain. Cutting things like funding for veterans is the definition of throwing the baby out with the bathwater.
Elissa

| | **LB3 gives Nebraska 5.**

**It is imperative that Nebraskans attend or testify in person at the upcoming Subcommittee hearing on[LB3 - Winner Take All](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8a48348604&e=25844e23a8). The hearing is currently scheduled for Thursday, Jan. 30th @ 1:30 pm - Room #1507. Online testimony to be entered into the record must be submitted and verified by Thursday, Jan. 30th at 8:00 am Central Time.**

[**FOR MORE INFORMATION GO TO OUR WEBSITE - NE.GOP/WTA**](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=db04fe8af1&e=25844e23a8)

[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=59bb2abbab&e=25844e23a8) **Winner Take All **\- Our state Governor, Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, Attorney General and both US Senators serve the whole state and are elected by the whole state. The US President serves the whole state and should be elected that way. Every Other State is winner-take-all except Maine. Why should we have to split our votes while California and the others do not? We should all be the same District or winner-take-all and right now we are an outlier. You may also just submit that you are a proponent if you do not want to write a testimony. **Remember to check your email after submitting testimony to complete the submission process. **Additionally, if you plan to attend the hearing on Thursday, please sign your name as a proponent on the sign-in sheet by the hearing door. You may go to the Legislature's web page for LB3 Winner Take All [HERE](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=3938f24e73&e=25844e23a8) and then click on the "Submit Comments Online for LB3" bar to proceed. You may also send your comments of support to the members of the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee. Their contact information may be found [HERE](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ea6b745878&e=25844e23a8). **\--Chairman Eric Underwood
Republican Party of Nebraska**

| | Last night, Trump took the most drastic step yet in his second term to screw over hard-working people. **He put a sweeping freeze on federal grants and loans.** If fully implemented, this freeze would endanger programs that put food on people's tables, fund early childhood education programs, and provide healthcare (I'm alarmed that Medicaid portals were down across the country today). It would kneecap nonprofits that offer essential services from housing assistance to nutrition. It would grind life-saving medical research to a halt. And it would severely hurt state and local governments – whose budgets rely in part upon federal grants. **Donald Trump wants to make life in America harder and costlier. He's willing to throw our economy into chaos and shut down the support systems that so many depend on. All because he'd rather raid the government's coffers for himself and his billionaire buddies.** I will do everything I can from the Senate to hold him accountable, stop the executive nominees who would carry out his destructive agenda, and make sure the American people understand exactly how they're being robbed. If fully implemented, this freeze would endanger programs that put food on people's tables, fund early childhood education programs, and provide healthcare (I'm alarmed that Medicaid portals were down across the country today). It would kneecap nonprofits that offer essential services from housing assistance to nutrition. It would grind life-saving medical research to a halt. And it would severely hurt state and local governments – whose budgets rely in part upon federal grants. Donald Trump wants to make life in America harder and costlier. He's willing to throw our economy into chaos and shut down the support systems that so many depend on. All because he'd rather raid the government's coffers for himself and his billionaire buddies. I will do everything I can from the Senate to hold him accountable, stop the executive nominees who would carry out his destructive agenda, and make sure the American people understand exactly how they're being robbed. body:
Indoctrination is happening in government schools all across the country

|

Friend,

In a survey released by the CATO Institute, younger Americans are increasingly viewing our Founders as villains.
[****](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zuemnrv4ho1f1r63v1na93mjjvnno8ed7pe8q4g8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj2cth2bs) Indoctrination is happening in government schools all across the country and the left's tactics to indoctrinate America’s youth are clearly working.

Here are more shocking statistics:
* 49% of students express support for socialism
* 68% fear expressing their opinion on campus
* 72% oppose allowing controversial speakers

Before the Tuttle Twins, freedom-loving parents didn’t have an easy and engaging way to teach the ideas of liberty to their children. They were left alone trying to shield their kids from the crazy ideas promoted by many teachers, government officials, and the media.

Through the Tuttle Twins, the Libertas Network is helping millions of parents reverse this trend by providing them with the tools necessary to educate their children and fight back against radical indoctrination.

[Our goal is to distribute another 1 million copies of the Tuttle Twins. Right now, a generous supporter is matching ALL donations. Can you donate $20, $40, $100, or even $250 today?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zh04bndgecshepvelaqmr8ofgurrmkk52cctvmj8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj2cth2bs)

You would be amazed at how well kids understand and love these ideas when they are explained simply with fully illustrated fun stories!

In addition to **The Tuttle Twins books** , we also have cartoons and curricula that bring the principles of a free society to life for families all over the country.

The Libertas Network is building a culture of liberty from the ground up for children and their families. Because politics is downstream of culture, and culture starts at home — with families.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from First Look is delivered on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2aqmoke44hvecc393jomsd8q5d291gcb07gbd4g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj6c3h2bs)
---
| |
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zsbsbrl0hpa8irqlkhmeih98ai07qct6af6k9igg_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj6c3h2bs) [NO](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ze7t28036vf1q8cc0b3h4s8lu3uce2ts75sr75m8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj6c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zokiu4d7785i56fm96ifd2sgv0vommgsr993sbt8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm8oj6c3h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2z62u1l3gi4kv906jju8k4mm156mk45tqpnkcfdvo_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm4p32c1h2bs) [NO](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2z2mo01637hu71oqbq1hsc6pk4ebcvl7g9i5r60r8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm4p32c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2z0rq44catg95fcuh7i7t2h2dka62dtskquglals8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0shgm4p32c1h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | | | | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001v-JQRgLvmM7bgKC9oZIMQm-UbWP0HAtMRBXuIf42bnde_LWIl9UJZvwoaTKudKJj-G1RIkKhLEuiIHvHiC5tqadhmqAUFItL8FFL7urezAhtKjrlXtl43Yh5CfW5mdOSqTe4dRZ9a4QB-WZH8VKgGQ==&c=l-eAsI9iCEuCuVPjHXJBvnYidKY-pI2PWixNZqCEH8dJzUQ7zLJjKQ==&ch=jGe--QPGw6D8CWBpEmyPpD9Zl3umOxWSMtxfVnh5f83oWR2yM3MNlQ==)

| Dear Peter,
January is all about reflecting on the wins of last year & laying a foundation of success for what's ahead. At least, that's how we're operating at the MassGOP...
Over on Beacon Hill, the go-along-to-get-along Democratic Supermajority seems to be stuck in their secretive, spending ways...
Just this month alone:
* The Healey-Driscoll Administration debuted their annual budget proposal - a stark 7.4% increase over the previous year, totalling a whopping $62,000,000,000 (yes - Billion!)
* The Healey Hotels full of migrants continue to be a breeding ground for violent crime and drugs, while costing taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars per day.
* Attorney General Andrea Campbell & Boston Mayor Michelle Wu couldn't let Gov. Healey steal the progressive spotlight. Campbell & Wu spent the month actively working against ICE in their efforts to keep Massachusetts residents safe.

There really couldn't be more proof that the Democratic Supermajority has gone too far in their progressive ideology.
I'm not afraid to say it - Beacon Hill no longer reflects the values of Massachusetts residents.
And the Democratic Supermajority can't spend their way out of every crisis. If November's wins proved anything, it's that resolution lies in the hands of the voters.
It's straightforward: if you seek legitimate solutions to the problems facing the Commonwealth, vote Republican in the next election.
---

clean_body: Indoctrination is happening in government schools all across the country | | | "Tuttle Twins" Friend, In a survey released by the CATO Institute, younger Americans are increasingly viewing our Founders as villains. Through the Tuttle Twins, the Libertas Network is helping millions of parents reverse this trend by providing them with the tools necessary to educate their children and fight back against radical indoctrination. To date, over 6 million copies of The Tuttle Twins have been distributed, making the ideas of liberty accessible to millions of young minds. Friend,

Coming off the HUGE victories last November, I am ready to shift things into the next gear. I have BIG plans for Turning Point PAC.

I want to personally invite you to be a part of it.

First, let’s recap what we achieved in 2024:
* Hispanic voters swung heavily toward Republicans and President Trump
* The youth vote (18-29) swung MAJORLY to President Trump.
* Republicans swept the White House, Senate, and Congress!

| | |
# Wednesday, January 29, 2025
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1861, a convention of delegates from across the state voted to [secede from the United States](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zz1uxCAQQOHTQLcWM4B_Coo07jZtSgub8XoUDCuD7N3bR0mfC7yn7-s-3T1HTo9Pv5OrrzVPqNDeFNxwmILn-J6MDG5WYQBJDjrdg1W603Jzwdh1Du2MZui97xCgh3boLJg-kLWLZPcbU4ADgAajGr_qpdW6BSRtjNbCKApc89HUjSq9fFnjO590NEveZXRbrc8i9IfAUeB4XVdTy-ZzipyoycdD4Lj5FOacvwWOlOrBVASOhRYqhXO6LTmdlCrnJA8XnhfHyKXthFGP3XP8-9R_4afDnwAAAP__Go1bkg). The following month, a popular referendum affirmed the decision to leave the Union by a vote of 44,317 to 13,020. The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department announced the [purchase of over 2,000 acres](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00D9vwyAQBfBPgzcsuPOfZGDo4i1dO1pnOBIUAhEmcfztq7RTh85Pv6en93WaTxRiSOdPurGpL59nUNBLpSUcZ0ch7nPXOLMod9QNGz3iQfcKR2wuxh_Iesu0KHC97dk5wJE0oD-MY78MTTDvMqXhqDXqTrXk0Q6IgwbGrkMUnWIXai5tvXDlF60-7vnJpbX51kRzqfW-CvwQMAmYtm1rry9K71DAtDxK4iptfqS6C5jWSpXl8thXCUopSbbwKrOXkZKTIck_QPpcZOJN_rI7lauAqSnG3bcQY1iHUXTqfKMQf8bUf995GvgOAAD__ygCaKk) for a new state park on Monday. ## Mexican Cartel Members Fire at Border Patrol Agents
Suspected Mexican cartel members [fired at U.S. Border Patrol agents](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuO5CAQheGnwRktoPAtINjEWW-6oVVtym0kDBZU395-5RlNONkvlfSpdP5d5yuGGNL9L-7k-L3m2SjTSqWlGWePIX5m23h3U37UDTndw6BbBT00m1strIvXfT9Y39m280MLFmFEDXa0qJvgTkxpM2oN2qoLrrB0AJ02BNYCCKvIB87lwhsxvbGu8ZOfVC5L3pvoNuajCvgjzCTMlD5HrnyehJlOWZhJ6bMHYaZHlYle9btuuXgq8kAuOUpMXu70DgsmuWBhinKn_UalSi7oSd4faQ2FJLKs-cEblfRDFDpyYWGmpjh_vEKMoXa9sOq-Y4hff_Kvwz2d-R8AAP__fBtv9w) Monday afternoon as a group of migrants attempted to cross the Rio Grande in Starr County. An agent fired a single shot in response, prompting the cartel members to flee. ## Hologram Exhibit Teaches Visitors About Holocaust
At the Dallas Holocaust and Human Rights Museum, visitors can interact with a 3D hologram of one of its founders, [Holocaust survivor Max Glauben](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFyhCAUANDTQKcD_wNKQZHGbtOmdL4LKhOEHSWre_tM0u8F3sz7uo03iinm5ZO24Oo1lxEE6EbIBuzoKabXqLh3k_BW8uBkh73UAjvkq8NZK7S99xamfvZWEPZaahIaJ22M4dH9YUKClRKlEi3NeDeIRkJApRCZEsHHWva2rqGGi445vcoz7O29bDy5tdbHwfCDwcBgOM-zrcdKJaeYQ1v2hcGwUvZTKd8MhpDrHsPBYFgS_UwhNxtdfHf-ccaU4mE6psSyUUz_fH37fTr4DQAA__-TRld6), who died in 2022 at the age of 94. As part of the "Dimensions in Testimony" exhibit, the hologram of Glauben is programmed to share details and answer questions about his experience living in the Warsaw Ghetto and several Nazi concentration camps. Created from [20 hours of interviews in 2018](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7tutDAQRp_GdEb2DJefwsXf0G3alGh8AUYyGGFn2c3TR6RP9xWfztH5fEwP4sj78kFbMOU1pwkUtFJpCcPkieN7aipvrPKDroLRPf7TrcIeq9WA611HuvW2tYNFrzsgN_fOejuA63zF5oYpDYPWqBtV04yuQ-w0BGwaRNGo4Lmksy5rKOFFeY7v9Axn7dJWRbOWcmSB_wWMAsbrumq_0ULfvIf7IWDc2J3pSLncm15yifRlwy6XULJcOcvMyy5LOo5wChir0_jj4hg5d71o1LIRx19Z-bP-aeAnAAD__80uXes), the hologram even replicates some of his mannerisms and favorite sayings. A local TV station joined Glauben’s son, Phil, during a visit to the museum on Monday, the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz. The station captured footage of Phil [having a conversation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGv4yAQhH8N7jaCBeO4cHGNu3ftldEaloAOxxHwwsu_Pzn9dTMa6ZPm-_N1-6KU0-P-m3Ze2k84bihxBKkA55unlN83M_hlk35WAy9q0lc1Sj3pIS7WS-u8RVKa7TXgiHYM26YQJzVOTg5pOWFS4ayUVkZeKGhntbYKWRujtTCSfWpHubTIjX-ohvw-Xlwu7tiHvMTWnlXoXwJXgWvv_dID0TkKXKm05DILXB_cq8A1ptqO8ha4esqZKuz0gPpk-luhpxYhU2MI1CIX6PGA-l1e6cUeWmSIRz4cfdf2SfdCOzR28XGWk4nXCTYMTqI1EMhewaCaYQ5yBKPNrNC7zc5yKIt_9pRzqnYSRt53Svnzp_1X8GvBfwEAAP__Nxl8bw) with the digital representation of his late father. "_This would have meant everything to him to witness people still using this_ ," Phil said. “ _He's the witness. He was the one who was there, and we're hearing that from him._ ”

## Federal Workers Get Buyout Offer
The Trump administration will offer millions of federal workers the option to accept buyouts through a government-wide “[deferred resignation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzGPhCAUBOBfA50GHj7FguIau732SgPyWLnDZYPsGv_9xeuvm2SSbzJft_lmY4qP-6fdyNSQZxCAjZANjLO3MZ1zx70JRECKk5GD0hIF9j1fjXVKaItycAv1FMZeedcpjd5JHZA6Hs2lCQmjlApRtKMODlEMS_AS0QLrBPlYc2m_c3zUlUI685tKu-SNJ7PW-tyZ-mAwMZiO42iXh1uuksF00QwmIa-sGUy1vLZn415nftW9CeSp2NQcufxQ2du1bokX459HTCnu_cA6cd9sTH9b9b_vbwO_AQAA__-r81qh)” program if they resign by Feb. 6, sources say. Workers who accept the offer will be compensated through Sept. 30. Military personnel, Postal Service employees, and workers in immigration enforcement or national security are not eligible. The White House [emailed federal employees](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuwyAQxvGngc0RdzY2DAxdvKVrR4uYI74WTIRJorx9le6dP32_4f91Xs6eE-_XT5_JtVgWVKg7BR3aJXhOr2WQwUUipF6Sg6k3oJUeR7k57YcRDPTKoDG9tSusZpomGofBejtGye6tKUAL0GutTtbEi9ZqWmMArT2KQVHgVurpu_DeNorpVR5UT2vJMrmttdsh-g-Bs8C5bbRxSu9N4LyVTDs9D4GzD5l3Plr1jcsucNYAqBR0rd7zrYsUqPrUPUv9oXp0l_ur3Nv7KKsLtyenxMc4iUFds-c_X7b_Wjwc_gYAAP__JCBgWg) Tuesday about the new program, noting that only 6% of the federal workforce has been full-time in-office since COVID. President Trump signed an executive order last week ending remote work for federal employees. The administration anticipates that between 5% and 10% of federal employees will accept the offer, potentially [saving taxpayers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOrCAYhZ8GO8wPiI4FhTc33mpus8WUhsEfh10EAzjGt9-4_XYnOTlfTr7Hfbpr511Y_usVVbFx4sAlBUZ5P83a-XNqqllZRI6iQsU6cWMSZNtWL9UC9tDxFoTg2Pdo4GlEB9CY1tygYZVTFw0Y7xkTUkLd3-xTSuiMnZmUmpMGcHYlpvozulBeaP0Z35hqE9fKq1cpWyZiIHwkfDyOo15zuDrCRwx0z4SPW_SuOHPF5ZqGFUMhfCxpXzcarcXkwkKf-xn3kmmJVHtPLc6YtKdHTF-YMs1xTwZp1ucF0okOAzvZv-FBxBiNm4n4--eyhEf-wLRVSc3b4bx3ue1IA8uqnf85XX6T-Fb8OwAA___4U3VN) up to $100 billion annually.
## Immigration Sweep Leads to 3,500 Arrests
ICE reported over [3,500 arrests of people with criminal records](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2uozAUhJ_GdEb2ARNSuMgWdNl2tRXyzzE5G7CzthNu3v6K9LeakUbzaTR_rvPV0Epx-W021DWkGQQoLiSH8-wNre-5b7wOiIBdg1qeulEqoYahuenRO2tHVLaDYZRWABiwEn3o-7GXVjWkD5qQcJayU0q05zFYpcTJBS-VMsB6gZ5qyu2_RLHeMKzv9MLcurQ1q77V-iisuzCYGEz7vrdbiUfGYMLIn4XBFHE_5OPJITc5Y6mFHxjeKSE4RU7bRks2lVLkLht392mP3D8zxYXX_NwehQfKpfId8c6tcfejlkIghwwmk_nlIr_-ll__m6z9Y6d1pTKcWC-WzdD62Vt_-u-l4TsAAP__JTFzyQ) this week, with Monday alone seeing 1,179 arrests. The operations included the capture of Anderson Zambrano-Pacheco in the Bronx, a [Tren de Aragua leader, wanted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdI7sBQMuXPwNXf72SrTgNdmTsSPjJOLtT1x_3Uij-TT6vu7zHTly2v7jTq6GPIMCI5WWYGePHM-5a7wLREBtQ04P7aiNMn3fPJxfugG0tcEsPfQBem-WcbS0IrYWKDTsLprSYLVujVE3O4bFGDWswWtjEESnyHPN5fadOdUHhXjmN5Xbmvcmuketz0O0_wRMAqZ0PvNRr0rAdIEFTEpfeRQwvQ6Z6HMImGqhJD1JLLi9UBZOm4yEnopcXkclLznJdK6S9523gpVzkgXZX-OmOP_8cIx89IPo1LYjx9879S89bwc_AQAA___TfmZ0) in Colorado for kidnapping and burglary. Suspected Mexican cartel members exchanged gunfire with U.S. Border Patrol agents near Fronton, Texas, on Monday as migrants attempted to cross the Rio Grande. See [drone footage and photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQhX8N3ojgbGxnYOjiLV07WsQcMRUG67gkzb-v3Kpjt096ep-e3sdlvriYYr69uw0thzKDAiOVlnCevYvpNXeNtwERsG3Q6qEdtVGm75vVYhgB0Pt-CF4bDW4cDOiuD6PGFkzfRHvYlIaz1q0x6nQew9UYNSxHwTgQnUIfudDps8TMK4b0Kg-k01K2JtmVea-ifRMwCZjyay-Vj0jAdIgFTEofPAqY7lVmfNZfuhbySHJ3TCVJl73c8CsuLsvFEWOSG25XpCqZnEd5u-cQCaVjWcudV6T8pyDcC7GAqSHr92dMKdZ-EJ26bS6mn538328PC98BAAD__0Sob9E). The ongoing immigration sweep drew a tearful, now-deleted Instagram video from singer Selena Gomez about "her people getting attacked." Border czar Tom Homan responded, saying he had "no apologies" and asking where her tears were for fentanyl victims and trafficked children. [Watch both videos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAUheGngS0WXLh2GBhaVak6pFOljhaGS0yFQ-QQW87TV-7e9Rzpk_7vc392Kafr5dNNZGssPQjAg5AHMH1wKW-95sFGIiDFycpOHSUKbFs-2tAFTwMOznSKNEodo4gweAOGojlqnuyuCQlGSoUoGnOMA6LofAwS0QHTgkKqZW5-SrrWkWLeykJz48vEsx1rvd2ZemFwYnBa17XZyqM-Btr_fXHVj0ydFqbe3l9bhKf6evoPPttwW1PO6d52TIvL5FL-I-t_iYuF3wAAAP__j6hSYg).
## List: How Americans Spend Their Money
A new analysis of [consumer spending](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FyhCAQQL8GOx1YRY6CIo3dpU3prLCcm0FxhJxzf5-59OnfvDfv6z7fkRPvj0_cyNWYZ5CgW6lasHNATq95aIKLREB9Q06Z_qa01OPYrG5E1Mtib9ZE8EOwUiplzKL8EGkwyjfs3japwCrVay07e4uL1tL4GJTWCGKQFLjms_vOvNeVYnrlJ52dz1uT3FrrUUT_IWASMF3X1T25_GDyeHDFxKW-QQHTmq8WNzrZ417actAe2roSn-2Wd3oJmJrThePilLiMRgzysSGnv0z9b_vp4DcAAP__rfpbEQ) revealed that Americans spend an average of $77,280 annually, with nearly half of expenditures earmarked for housing and transportation.

On an annual basis, Americans spend roughly $25,000 a year on housing, $13,000 on transportation, $6,000 on food at home, another $4,000 on food away from home, and around $3,500 on entertainment.

On average, annual health spending is another $6,000, and personal insurance and pension payments are nearly $10,000.

On the other hand, spending on reading is only about $120 a year. You can see the [full breakdown of how we spend our money here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FyhCAQQL8GOx1YRY6CIo3dpU3prLCcm0FxhJxzf5-59OnfvDfv6z7fkRPvj0_cyNWYZ5CgW6lasHNATq95aIKLREB9Q06Z_qa01OPYrG5E1Mtib9ZE8EOwUiplzKL8EGkwyjfs3japwCrVay07e4uL1tL4GJTWCGKQFLjms_vOvNeVYnrlJ52dz1uT3FrrUUT_IWASMF3X1T25_GDyeHDFxKW-QQHTmq8WNzrZ417actAe2roSn-2Wd3oJmJrThePilLiMRgzysSGnv0z9b_vp4DcAAP__rfpbEQ)

# [The first known vending machine dispensed holy water.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| B ecause vending machines are now automated, they can feel like a relatively modern invention. However, the basic contraption has actually been around for more than 2,000 years. Introduced around the first century CE by Greek engineer and mathematician Heron of Alexandria, the first vending machine didn’t deliver snacks — it [dispensed holy water](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Similar to modern machines, Heron’s device required inserting a coin into a slot. The coin fell onto a pan that was connected to a lever, which opened a valve on the other end where the holy water flowed out. The pan continued to move under the weight of the coin until, eventually, the coin slid off. The lever would then raise back to its initial state and close the valve, stopping the flow of water.
---
The machine — described by Heron as a “sacrificial vessel” — was made to [limit the amount of holy water](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) people were using at ancient temples. (This was during the Hellenistic period, when Alexandria was a multicultural hub for various Roman, Greek, and Egyptian faiths.) Heron’s invention didn’t stick around with any regularity until centuries later, however. Throughout the 1600s and 1700s, coin-operated machines were used to sell tobacco in English taverns, and by the 1800s, they were selling everything from banned literary works to stamps. In 1888, a new chewing gum called Tutti-Frutti appeared in custom penny-operated vending machines on New York City subway platforms, introducing the United States to vending machines as we know them today.

## The microwave was invented by accident.
During World War II, Allied forces gained a significant tactical advantage by deploying the world’s first true radar system. The success of this system increased research into microwaves and the magnetrons (a type of electron tube) that generate them. One day around 1946, [Percy Spencer](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=squn0u&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), an engineer at the aerospace and defense company Raytheon, stepped in front of an active radar set and noticed, to his surprise, that microwaves produced from the radar melted a candy bar in his pocket. After getting over his shock — and presumably cleaning up — Spencer conducted a few more experiments using eggs and popcorn kernels, and realized that microwaves could be used to cook a variety of foods. Raytheon patented the invention a short time later, and in 1947, the company released its first microwave.

clean_body: Because vending machines are now automated, they can feel like a relatively modern invention. | B ecause vending machines are now automated, they can feel like a relatively modern invention. However, the basic contraption has actually been around for more than 2,000 years. Introduced around the first century CE by Greek engineer and mathematician Heron of Alexandria, the first vending machine didn’t deliver snacks — it . Similar to modern machines, Heron’s device required inserting a coin into a slot. The coin fell onto a pan that was connected to a lever, which opened a valve on the other end where the holy water flowed out. The pan continued to move under the weight of the coin until, eventually, the coin slid off. The lever would then raise back to its initial state and close the valve, stopping the flow of water. The machine — described by Heron as a “sacrificial vessel” — was made to people were using at ancient temples. (This was during the Hellenistic period, when Alexandria was a multicultural hub for various Roman, Greek, and Egyptian faiths.) Heron’s invention didn’t stick around with any regularity until centuries later, however. Throughout the 1600s and 1700s, coin-operated machines were used to sell tobacco in English taverns, and by the 1800s, they were selling everything from banned literary works to stamps. In 1888, a new chewing gum called Tutti-Frutti appeared in custom penny-operated vending machines on New York City subway platforms, introducing the United States to vending machines as we know them today. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Approximate number of vending machines in the U.S. 7 million | | Average amount an American spends on vending machines each year $27 | Average amount an American spends on vending machines each year $27 | | Year when labels warning against tilting were added to U.S. vending machines 1995 | | Approximate number of Snickers candy bars manufactured every day 15 million | Approximate number of Snickers candy bars manufactured every day 15 million | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- The microwave was invented by accident. During World War II, Allied forces gained a significant tactical advantage by deploying the world’s first true radar system. The success of this system increased research into microwaves and the magnetrons (a type of electron tube) that generate them. One day around 1946, , an engineer at the aerospace and defense company Raytheon, stepped in front of an active radar set and noticed, to his surprise, that microwaves produced from the radar melted a candy bar in his pocket. After getting over his shock — and presumably cleaning up — Spencer conducted a few more experiments using eggs and popcorn kernels, and realized that microwaves could be used to cook a variety of foods. Raytheon patented the invention a short time later, and in 1947, the company released its first microwave. # **We cannot let RFK destroy public health.**
---
|
---
| | | | Hello friend, We need to talk about RFK. It’s unbelievable that we live in a world where this deranged lunatic is about to become **our next Secretary of HHS.** Even worse, we've reached a point where Republicans think it's acceptable to bring back diseases like polio, measles, and smallpox. Anyone who claims otherwise simply isn’t paying attention. When RFK goes on national television and spreads lies about childhood vaccines being linked to autism, he is actively encouraging vulnerable parents to ignore their pediatricians, school administrators, scientists, and global experts—because he thinks he knows better. Right now, tens of thousands of children remain unvaccinated due to conspiracy theorists and propagandists like RFK. As a parent of three young children, this infuriates me. This is a privileged, white drug addict—his cousin’s words, not mine. If you haven't seen Ambassador Catherine Kennedy’s video, I strongly encourage you to watch it. The hypocrisy is nauseating, to say the least. Trump, RFK, and Republican senators all vaccinate their own children and loved ones but want everyday Americans to forgo vaccines, leaving kids exposed to diseases we’ve already conquered. My father-in-law had polio as a child—one leg is longer than the other. He lives with the lasting effects of this disease. Don’t you think he wishes his parents had the option to vaccinate him? Yet here we are, forced into this pointless and dangerous debate—all because Trump won. Today’s RFK hearing was infuriating, but it also exposed the deep flaws in his arguments. The good news? The majority of Americans—Democrats, Republicans, and Independents—agree that childhood vaccines work and that polio and smallpox belong in the past. We need to keep reminding people of that and continue exposing the Trump disaster unfolding before our eyes. During today’s hearing, Senator Hassan tore apart RFK’s hypocritical flip-flopping on abortion. Let’s be clear: Republicans envision a country where they control every aspect of our lives. They want women to be subservient to men. For many of them, the abortion debate isn’t about religion—it’s about power. And right now, they are dangerously close to getting exactly what they want. But that’s where we come in. Trump has already been forced to reverse some of his executive orders—whether by judges or overwhelming public outrage. Even Republican governors are urging him to slow down and think before signing more disastrous policies. What a novel concept, right? We must keep up the pressure, keep making noise, and keep educating the public. That is our mission for the next two years. And we need your help to do it. I know people are angry—I’ve seen the emails, and I set aside 5-6 hours each week to respond to as many as possible. If I haven’t gotten to yours yet, know that every email is read and absorbed. We’re in this fight together. Let’s keep pushing forward. In Solidarity, Hassan Martini

The Fight to Protect Christian Attorneys| | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4cc533e776ba4e42a455fd67e3c56b97&_e=gVtVDdHJ9W1w54O2xsW27-po9IgulqL-3-uKRj2Fzp3cHDh_CRAWOk2GZcZoYslFVsYuuNOQfa8f2cUy_n0Ntj4JoOASDMNxObxvbykdM1DOYVIann1aFdSjf23nnHCD3OeGdWo0Fcv8oz2luUd_YAYXq2R5oyS8HZRH9jqlC9dYbWUah33Cb2pejVHAxEcfxLQ2eU_DTNFQlLEkvWX0yKHhNkYJ9mDTvRgqdg63GXwV7N1l77aZDn4KUaSB_1jQqi_1ybAGhZDaIOKtH-dfbTM1NGwJxyzQmyG1uQc6UaIFXUFPaHO9ilCDcDkpOlMS)
---
Peter, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life . . . yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it! **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith--like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can't be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** --IMPOSSIBLE to pursue . . . . . . and leave Christians and Americans of faith, alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools, without ANY legal defense when they wrongly and unconstitutionally face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Peter, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** _**[_**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**_](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4cc533e776ba4e42a455fd67e3c56b97&_e=gVtVDdHJ9W1w54O2xsW27-po9IgulqL-3-uKRj2Fzp3cHDh_CRAWOk2GZcZoYslFVsYuuNOQfa8f2cUy_n0Ntj4JoOASDMNxObxvbykdM1DOYVIann1aFdSjf23nnHCD3OeGdWo0Fcv8oz2luUd_YAYXq2R5oyS8HZRH9jqlC9ciLi7eMP1O-EyQX2uzyUu-h-TQHNYnfb8Zp0gS5PBVf-Hzmfkl0Y7iBHEoBn-yGMpJZC2JCX8nW2-zcVW8Tl3y6plrUhZ2bh9bQrYlBNQodxC_--KLRyfsRUKHtfD8VUMlpjefU_G6AzjGi5wYAzQD)**_
---
[**Support Christian Legal Society**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4cc533e776ba4e42a455fd67e3c56b97&_e=gVtVDdHJ9W1w54O2xsW27-po9IgulqL-3-uKRj2Fzp3cHDh_CRAWOk2GZcZoYslFVsYuuNOQfa8f2cUy_n0Ntj4JoOASDMNxObxvbykdM1DOYVIann1aFdSjf23nnHCD3OeGdWo0Fcv8oz2luUd_YAYXq2R5oyS8HZRH9jqlC9f-RCWHrGEOvOL3WKyBix2ZRHZJfZTP20RFSndEzHl5OeBTWsRyfA4bs3ryFhFNT6mKsukwofgc9OMIiaqwrZ6UYuZn6qOljzMCJzSbJGVwA30lDdqeZbZSaHr6zywuZGe1YY_4ZawwRGKvjtcrvJfj)
---
For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has devastating real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys --and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend--seems to be the sole goal of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed . . . without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that radical activists could use this to:
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as "progressive" or "Woke");

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches,** sitting on church boards, or serving schools they've gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing pro bono work** **to defend religious freedom** on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Peter, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America . . . but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight--and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith--I'm counting on your support. _**[_**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys . . . and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**_](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4cc533e776ba4e42a455fd67e3c56b97&_e=gVtVDdHJ9W1w54O2xsW27-po9IgulqL-3-uKRj2Fzp3cHDh_CRAWOk2GZcZoYslFVsYuuNOQfa8f2cUy_n0Ntj4JoOASDMNxObxvbykdM1DOYVIann1aFdSjf23nnHCD3OeGdWo0Fcv8oz2luUd_YAYXq2R5oyS8HZRH9jqlC9cPL0IM3QDfGyhEtdcMbUdyDHXpaXxsutHcHwMP3rX6LIG0zr7M59h8WVNgAAJouWntOz_XzLo2vb4W8mvSLlAEOw7yNelApi3p6GII3riCMD5pSkU1wOUSN49ykchbhwQ3wppnYoQkEHufwTtWGbzX)**_
---

Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been a fellowship of Christians dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society.** _**[That's why I encourage you--and hope--that you'll make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help Christian Legal Society WIN critical victories in the battles still to come.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4cc533e776ba4e42a455fd67e3c56b97&_e=gVtVDdHJ9W1w54O2xsW27-po9IgulqL-3-uKRj2Fzp3cHDh_CRAWOk2GZcZoYslFVsYuuNOQfa8f2cUy_n0Ntj4JoOASDMNxObxvbykdM1DOYVIann1aFdSjf23nnHCD3OeGdWo0Fcv8oz2luUd_YAYXq2R5oyS8HZRH9jqlC9eilu2wof1h-fgpAFVETYA2SRK9hDGOqhDSw67A7VumktipQTPg54KxLjDVT0zfct3cXFdi58srt2uVQ90o1_uzBY4CWZ253nOWN87-Rb56iJ2Cj2oyMhrB85iRiJsFgyPHeJK1U0kLxALJfiZIhwh5)**_ Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. David Nammo
Executive Director & CEO
Christian Legal Society

President Trump gave us the blueprint for winning

| | | [](https://trk.emails.troydowning._AqA)
---
Peter,

Did you see the news? President Trump just scored a major victory over the Colombian government.

When Colombia tried to block deportation flights filled with illegal immigrants from landing, President Trump didn’t hesitate. He enacted 25% tariffs on Colombian imports, and within HOURS, the Colombian President reversed course – allowing the flights to resume.

_**THIS is what winning looks like, Peter, and it's just the beginning.**_

President Trump is proving once again that he means business. Now, it’s up to us to show our support and keep this momentum going. **[**Will you stand with President Trump and his bold plans to put America First? Sign your name now!**](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)**

# [#]
Peter: Did you see our email from yesterday?

If not, there are just two takeaways we didn’t want you to miss:

1. Trump has only been in office for a week and he’s already released DOZENS of executive orders that will irrevocably harm Black and Latino communities.
2. Thursday is our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we’re aiming to raise $3,000 before then. Right now we’re only about 65% to that goal.

Will you pitch in now to help us in the fight against the Trump regime? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top-em-jan25]

DONATE NOW » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top-em-jan25]

⬇️ Read our email from yesterday below for more details on Trump’s executive orders...

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Texas Organizing Project PAC
Date: Tues, Jan 28, 2025
Subject: 3 of Trump’s despicable executive orders
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Hi Peter,

We reached out yesterday to tell you about our January end-of-month fundraising deadline and $3,000 fundraising goal. If you’d like, you can pitch in before Friday with a donation of any amount right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top-em-jan25]

But if you need convincing, here’s exactly what’s on the line. Donald Trump has only been in office for one week, but he’s already damaging our country and sowing chaos. To name just three of his despicable executive orders:

❌ Trump has moved to end birthright citizenship in an executive order that stands in DIRECT opposition to the 14th Amendment.
❌ Trump has called to eliminate certain environmental justice programs that protect low-income, Black, and Latino Americans.
❌ Trump is terminating all diversity, equity, and inclusion programs across the federal government — impacting thousands of federal jobs.

We’re fighting back against the Trump regime, but we need YOUR support to do so. Can you pitch in just $7 towards our end-of-month fundraising push today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top-em-jan25?amount=7]

If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.

Hi Peter,

If we haven’t met, my name is Madison Horn.

In 2024, I ran to represent Oklahoma’s 5th Congressional District. I think it’s important to share a bit about that experience with you today:

When I first connected with Her Bold Move, I had already reached out to nearly every major women’s organization in the country. I was running for office in Oklahoma — a state ranked as the worst place in the US for women, with the strictest abortion laws and a staggering **_50% of women experiencing rape or domestic violence in their lifetime._** Despite this dire reality, my candidacy as a woman seeking to become the most credentialed cybersecurity lawmaker in Congress received little to no support.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101154993/525094505/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250124vote_N_EH_90DO_7_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyZWUzMjU3LTQ5ZGUtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xoWiQZDpuqfHjF2z8RFgVxXUEnV7k3qg7fX5Y4jFnRQ=)
---
It was disheartening. These were organizations with bold mission statements about empowering women. Yet, when faced with a challenging race, the response was silence (or, even worse, excuses like, _“Your race is too difficult”_). Time and again, I was left wondering: If the most well-funded organizations won’t stand by their missions, what is their purpose? If women are to step into leadership, we must step into the arena together, no matter the odds.

That’s why, **when I received the news that Her Bold Move was endorsing me, I was nearly brought to tears. It wasn’t just about the endorsement. It was about an organization that believed women in Oklahoma — no matter how uphill the battle — were worth fighting for.** It was about an organization willing to live its mission and declare, loudly and clearly: We are in this fight with you. Even knowing the odds, they chose to stand boldly and take action.

[**Before I share more, will you join me in supporting them by pitching in $20.25 or more today so they can continue to support candidates running for office this year and beyond?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101154995/525094518/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250129Horn_N_MH_90DO_11_G_N_L1&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyZWUzMjU3LTQ5ZGUtZWYxMS04OGY4LTAwMjI0ODJhOTU3OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xoWiQZDpuqfHjF2z8RFgVxXUEnV7k3qg7fX5Y4jFnRQ=)

What happened next left me even more in awe. **The day after my endorsement, four different resources from Her Bold Move reached out to offer media support, social media strategy, volunteer assistance, and seasoned advisors.** I couldn’t believe it. For the first time, I felt like I wasn’t on an island shouting into the void about the harsh realities in Oklahoma. **Her Bold Move didn’t just endorse me;_they joined my fight,_ shoulder to shoulder.**

Their commitment went beyond words or symbolic gestures. **In a state where the status quo means accepting the highest rates of rape and domestic violence in the country, Her Bold Move rejected complacency.** They took a stand knowing this might not be a seat to win this time. They chose bold action over safe bets, proving that their mission wasn’t just rhetoric – it was a promise to women across America.

**_Her Bold Move’s support was a lifeline for me_ , and it reignited my belief that change is possible when we act with courage and conviction. They’ve shown that, to create a better future, we must take bold steps today. Even in the face of what seem like impossible odds.**

To anyone seeking an example of what it means to truly support women, look no further than Her Bold Move. They are more than an organization; they are a movement — and one that I will forever be grateful for.

subject: Here's how EMILYs List women have responded to the overturn of Roe v. Wade
body:
Democratic pro-choice women are the best weapon in this fight |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/101165056/525125349/-1491281772?refcode=WUEFE161_20250129_RoeMemo_ALL_v1s2&sourceid=1055637&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmU5MDhiOS01MWRlLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=szPzNor4X8zx11jLl7XxvmzW2SFOVDE4ZFLdGbyWJp8=) Peter, this country is in a reproductive rights crisis. And the man responsible? Donald Trump.

On _day one (!!)_ of his administration, Trump removed the government website reproductiverights.gov — a resource that provided crucial information about reproductive health care, including abortion care. He reinstated the global gag rule and pardoned anti-choice extremists who blocked access to health care clinics.

| | **Join our neighbor states and make Nebraska Winner Take All**

**It is imperative that Nebraskans attend or testify in person at the upcoming Subcommittee hearing on[LB3 - Winner Take All](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d17510e2ca&e=25844e23a8). The hearing is currently scheduled for Thursday, Jan. 30th @ 1:30 pm - Room #1507. Online testimony to be entered into the record must be submitted and verified by Thursday, Jan. 30th at 8:00 am Central Time.**

[**FOR MORE INFORMATION GO TO OUR WEBSITE - NE.GOP/WTA**](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f003fb51b8&e=25844e23a8)

[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=f27f4735b1&e=25844e23a8) **Winner Take All **\- This is it, Republicans. George Soros money, Bill Gates money, OUTSIDERS impact your elections and fund ALL the Liberal agendas in your local races, your land grab candidates, your Green New Deal candidates, your DEI candidates! THIS is why the Democrat machine spends MILLIONS of dollar in Nebraska...because we LET THEM! Their (Liberal Dark Money) control of Nebraska Politics ENDS in 2025. _**Nebraska Money for Nebraska Candidates**_
General Knowledge: The Electoral College has 538 votes, 270 is 50% + 1, and is needed to win the presidency. Each state has two electoral votes for their two US Senators and one vote each for their US Representative. Wyoming has the smallest population and has three electoral votes; California has the largest with 55 votes. In Nebraska, the “District Plan” was proposed in 1990 and again in 1991 and failed both times. It then passed in 1992 (by a simple majority of 25 votes). In 1995 and 1997 the legislature reversed course and returned to Winner Take All, but both times was vetoed by democrat governor Ben Nelson. No other states have joined the District Plan. If it was such a good idea CA, MA, NY, IL, CO would join. They don’t because much of their state is red! This puts NE out of step in the Electoral College Process. **Argument** – That District Plan gives you a voice for your vote (a feeling). Is this only if the election goes your way? How do you measure a feeling? **Argument** – The District Plan increases grassroots participation and voter turnout. No! The candidate and their policies drive support and turnout. **Argument** – The District Plan will encourage presidential candidates to visit NE. NE has only five electoral votes. Any candidate would visit OMA across from IA, with a large population center. The District Plan discourages candidates from addressing issues that appeal to the ENTIRE state by rewarding candidates to visit congressional districts with higher population and income levels, to the exclusion of rural NE. **Argument** – The District Plan encourages third-party candidates to capture their share of electoral votes, increasing the likelihood that NO ONE candidate receives the needed 270 (majority of 538) electoral votes. This would mean the US House of Representatives would decide the Presidency.
You may also just submit that you are a proponent if you do not want to write a testimony. **Remember to check your email after submitting testimony to complete the submission process. **Additionally, if you plan to attend the hearing on Thursday, please sign your name as a proponent on the sign-in sheet by the hearing door. You may go to the Legislature's web page for LB3 Winner Take All [HERE](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=03a2638348&e=25844e23a8) and then click on the "Submit Comments Online for LB3" bar to proceed. You may also send your comments of support to the members of the Government, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee. Their contact information may be found [HERE](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=279c946bb7&e=25844e23a8). **\--Chairman Eric Underwood
Republican Party of Nebraska**

clean_body: | | | | | Donald Trump campaigned on grievance and revenge, so no one should be surprised that he is nominating dangerously unprepared and inexperienced candidates whose top qualification seems to be their loyalty to Trump above all else – and his selection of RFK Jr. is a stark example. RFK Jr. is a notorious anti-vaxxer and fringe conspiracy theorist. As head of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), there’s no telling how far he could set America back in terms of public health, reproductive rights, research and innovation, and so much more. The consequences here are not theoretical or superficial – health care access, coverage, research, and public health are life or death issues for people. The last time Donald Trump was president, he sent the uninsured rate skyrocketing and quite possibly did irreparable damage to trust in public health – and he has made clear he plans to do much worse in a second term, no matter the consequences. | | Thanks for standing with me, Patty Murray | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. name: Mark Kelly
subject: President Trump’s recklessness could cause real, widespread harm
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I have heard from folks in every corner of Arizona — mayors, county supervisors, community organizations, and everyday Arizonans who are worried about how this is going to impact them.
#

Team —
On Monday night, President Trump’s Office of Management and Budget released a memo ordering all funding for “grant, loan and other financial assistance programs” to be paused. It’s hard to tell exactly what funds are frozen, but I can tell you this:
I have heard from folks in every corner of Arizona — mayors, county supervisors, community organizations, business owners, and everyday Arizonans — who are worried about how this is going to impact them.
This order was written so broadly, so carelessly, that up to $3 trillion in government support for working families, veterans, small businesses, police, firefighters, and more are at risk. It threatens things like cancer research, Meals on Wheels, food assistance for hungry kids and seniors, Head Start child care programs, housing for homeless veterans. Millions of Americans could be harmed by President Trump’s recklessness.
Beyond all that, this is almost certainly an unconstitutional power grab. Congress approved the funding for these programs, and the administration’s role is to execute them. This is Article One of the Constitution, folks. It is the foundation of our system of government, and states and organizations around the country are already filing lawsuits.
But I want to focus on this team right now — what you can do to help as we fight back. And the most important thing, really, is that you add your voice. The more people who hear about this overreach, the more who speak out, the better we can all push back.
[**Add your name here and commit to spreading the word that President Trump’s administration is throwing the country into chaos, causing real harm, and then get out there and speak out.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/federal_aid_em_jan25/?source=em250129-1-180&akid=5954%2E6688874%2EvKCDMJ)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/federal_aid_em_jan25/?source=em250129-1-180&akid=5954%2E6688874%2EvKCDMJ)**
Thanks for your help. We’ll have more soon.
Mark

The first thought that entered my mind was, "Trump's funding freeze will kill people."
In my home state of Illinois, Governor Pritzker's office confirmed that Trump's funding freeze has completely shut Illinois out of Medicaid. Four million Illinoisans rely on Medicaid for their healthcare, including my own loved ones. And it was not just Illinois. Every single Medicaid portal in all 50 states was down. It's critical we document what happened, the Trump regime's backtracking, and what legal steps we can take _this week_ to better ensure this does not happen again. **Let 's Address This.**

**This article has three parts:**
1. Documenting the disaster of Trump's spending freeze.
2. National outrage, lawsuits, and the Trump regime backtracks (temporarily).
3. What steps you can take to support the lawsuits and protect our critical services.

### 1\. Trump's Spending Freeze is a Disaster
On Monday the Trump regime attempted to freeze spending on $3T of Congressional appropriated funds. As a result of Trump's reckless and illegal freeze, by Tuesday:
* Medicaid portals crashed nationwide--millions of low-income Americans were at risk of losing access to lifesaving healthcare overnight. Keep in mind that Medicaid covers 41% of all births in America. The "pro life" party that constantly screams about "declining birth rates," but won't fund universal healthcare, won't fund pre-K, won't fund child tax credit, won't fund school lunches, and now eliminates healthcare needed for 2 of every 5 babies. Again, this will kill people.
* Section 8 housing assistance was suspended--putting people relying on vouchers to keep a roof over their heads at risk of homelessness.
* Head Start and University grants are being thrown into chaos--Professors and low-income children and students could lose access to critical education programs.
* Food prices are rising even faster--eggs are already more expensive than they were three months ago, and this freeze will only exacerbate economic instability.

This is what happens when a fascist attempts to seize power that does not belong to him. Donald Trump claims this is about ensuring "money isn't being wasted on DEI initiatives." But that's a blatant lie. This is an extension of his authoritarian Project 2025 agenda--a plan designed to dismantle diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and ultimately, any federal programs that help the most vulnerable Americans.
When pressed, the White House finally issued a statement claiming they never intended to freeze Medicaid or Medicare, and that the media lied. This deflection is an example of the Trump regime refusing to take responsibility for their reckless behavior. But it's also a reminder that raising your voice in outrage matters, and we cannot afford to be silent against Trump's attempts to advance his autocracy. Because if he is allowed to continue unchecked, things will only get worse.
Meanwhile, MAGA voters cheering Trump on do not seem to realize that his funding freeze would disproportionately harming low-income white people. Why? Because the largest demographic of Americans who rely on the federal welfare benefits that Trump is trying to freeze are low income white Americans. Indeed, nine of the top 10 states reliant on federal welfare are GOP run states. The MAGA racist obsession with the myth of Black and brown people "abusing welfare" is full circle. Dying of whiteness, as Professor Jonathan Metzer's book declares, is real. Fortunately, left leaning organizations and Democrat attorneys generals are stepping up to protect _all_ Americans, regardless of party affiliation.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Zu53hEDeZpPHrFCS4UfrvCtVlQ1vqCAka2D8LGbziMs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=155989101)
### 2\. Who Is Fighting Back?
Legal challenges are mounting in response to Trump's reckless and unilateral decision to freeze federal spending. While a coalition of state attorneys general is set to file a major lawsuit, The National Council of Nonprofits and several other organizations have wasted no time already filing their suit.1 They sued the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and its Acting Director, Matthew Vaeth, in federal court, seeking an emergency temporary restraining order (TRO). The plaintiffs argued (correctly) that Trump's freeze is not only devastating but also blatantly illegal, as it violates the separation of powers by overriding Congress's control over federal spending. U.S. District Judge Loren AliKhan issued a TRO, blocking the freeze. However, this TRO expires on February 3 at 5 p.m.
That is why this next lawsuit by attorneys general from 22 states and D.C. is so critical. These states are challenging Trump's authority to unilaterally block funding that has already been lawfully approved by Congress, emphasizing that his executive action is a clear violation of constitutional law. Here are the 23 states and DC whose attorneys general have filed suit against Trump's spending freeze:
> Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin, and Washington D.C.
These states and AGs are taking a stand to protect their residents from Trump's reckless and illegal power grab, ensuring that critical programs like Medicaid, housing assistance, and education funding remain intact. They are fighting for all Americans, regardless of party affiliation. That is how justice is _supposed_ to work. Remarkably but unsurprisingly, not a single Republican attorney general has so far joined this lawsuit-- even though such a freeze would hurt their own constituents the most.
This legal battle is far from over, but one thing is clear: Trump's actions are not only cruel but unconstitutional. The courts must act swiftly to block this unlawful power grab before more lives are put in jeopardy. And you can help. Here's how.

### 3\. How Do We Support These Lawsuits?
If your state AG is on the above list, call their office and thank them. It is always good to reward our elected officials by telling them when they are doing a good job. On the other hand, if your state's Republican attorney general is _not_ on the above list, call them and demand they join this lawsuit to protect you and your neighbors. It is good and critical we tell our elected officials when they are screwing up. The below link allows you to select your state and go directly to your respective attorney general.

This may seem like a small act, but in large numbers it works. For example, just this week ICE shut down its immigration snitch line because too many people allegedly called in fake reports. Mass movements work! Find your AG, call them to either thank them, or demand they join this lawsuit to stop Trump's fascist funding freeze. And then forward this article to everyone you know and ask them to call as well.

## Conclusion
Trump has already signaled that this budget freeze is just the beginning. If he gets his way, fully gutting Medicaid, Section 8 housing, SNAP, and Social Security will all be next. If you're angry, good. You should be. Channel that anger into action and do it this week.
I will continue to provide updates as they develop. Subscribe below to receive them in your inbox as I publish them. For now, we do not have the luxury of apathy. We do not have the time for inaction. We need the clarity of purpose and the courage to take action. Call and demand your State attorney general join the lawsuit to permanently ban Trump's freeze on vital health and care. Make your voice heard.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
If you are near Colorado Springs or want to make the trek, I'd love to see you TOMORROW, January 30th at [Taste of The Peak](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a fun-fundraiser for The Peak News Educational Foundation to Benefit their "Journalistic Ethics and Media Vocational Training Program" for Pikes Peak-area youth. I'll be speaking alongside D11 School Board Member Jason Jorgenson, Salem Media's Chris Gould, Congressman Jeff Crank, and The Peak's Chaim Goldman! [RSVP here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Hope to see you there!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Rep. Stephanie Luck questioned why enrolled tribal members are not included in [Colorado’s American Indian Affairs Committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), pushing for their direct involvement in decision-making. Rep. Matt Soper is calling for urgent reform in Colorado’s criminal justice system as [rape kit processing delays](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) now exceed 400 days.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Coloradans must [actively opt-in](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for their Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights (TABOR) refunds when filing state taxes this year, or they risk missing out on money owed to them. Gov. Polis denies [Colorado is a sanctuary state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), but legislation limiting ICE enforcement and data-sharing restrictions indicate otherwise. Meanwhile, U.S. Rep. Jeff Hurd held a [ceremonial oath of office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado’s 3rd District to engage constituents who couldn't attend the official swearing-in.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump has issued a flurry of executive orders. [See the full list here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) China’s [DeepSeek AI](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is making headlines with a low-cost chatbot rivaling ChatGPT, sparking concerns about U.S. dominance in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity threats. The White House has implemented a [freeze on all federal grants and loans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), allowing Trump's administration to review government spending and tighten control over trillions of federal dollars.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Cory Gaines points out the inconsistency in Attorney General Phil Weiser’s stance, opposing federal immigration enforcement while insisting that local sheriffs enforce state [Red Flag laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). As Colorado joins a lawsuit challenging Trump’s executive order [ending birthright citizenship](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Stephen McKenna argues the courts may decide the issue, but a constitutional amendment would be the most definitive route.
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, January 29, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl

**[Ganahl: The actions of Gov. Polis and Democrats speak louder than words — Colorado is a sanctuary state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Despite Colorado Gov. Jared Polis’ assertions to the contrary, the state has increasingly been adopting policies and laws that align with the characteristics of a sanctuary state, significantly limiting the enforcement capabilities of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) within its borders.
Discussions have been vibrant on the topic of whether Colorado should be considered a sanctuary state, given the state’s legislative actions over the past few years.
One of the most significant pieces of legislation is HB23-1100, which fundamentally restricts local governments’ ability to contract with ICE for the detention of immigrants in local jails. This bill also bans the establishment of private immigration detention centers in Colorado, a move that critics argue hinders ICE’s operational effectiveness. This law directly impacts how and where ICE can detain individuals who are in the country illegally, particularly those with criminal convictions or pending charges.

**[Rep. Soper joining sex-assault victims to urge reform in addressing 400-day rape kit processing delays](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's rape kit backlog now exceeds 400 days, far surpassing the state’s 90-day goal, delaying justice for survivors and allowing perpetrators to remain free.
* State Representative Matt Soper is leading efforts to address the backlog, advocating for additional resources, forensic lab improvements, and stricter oversight to prevent future delays.
* Sexual assault survivors testified at the state legislature, sharing emotional stories about the lasting impact of delayed justice and urging lawmakers to take immediate action to resolve the crisis.

**[Rep. Luck questions why tribal members aren’t part of Colorado’s American Indian Affairs Committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Stephanie Luck raised concerns over the exclusion of enrolled tribal members from Colorado’s newly proposed American Indian Affairs Committee, arguing that they should have decision-making roles rather than just advisory input.
* Despite concerns, House Bill 25-1057 advanced to the Appropriations Committee with a 10-1 vote, with Rep. Luck as the sole opponent due to the lack of direct tribal representation.
* Bill sponsors suggested that tribal seats could be added later, but some lawmakers, including Rep. Brandi Bradley, questioned why they were not included from the start.

* Judge Gordon Gallagher emphasized Hurd’s responsibility in representing the vast and diverse 3rd Congressional District, which includes rural communities, tribal nations, and major economic hubs across Western Colorado.
* Hurd highlighted his committee assignments, including House Natural Resources, Transportation and Infrastructure, and Science and Space, pledging to advocate for Colorado’s energy, water, and infrastructure needs.

**[Gaines: Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser on Trump directives vs. his Red Flag Law position](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I saw a recent CPR article about the conflict between Trump’s directives on immigration and Colorado’s sanctuary state laws._
_In that article, the reporter put up a statement by our own Colorado Attorney General (and gubernatorial candidate) Phil Weiser. That statement is in the screenshot linked above._
_I thought it would make an interesting contrast to compare what AG Weiser said re. Trump policy vs. Colorado sanctuary law to what AG Weiser said not too long after passage of Colorado’s Red Flag Law._

This case is still going on in North Carolina, Team, and we have to spread the word because the media is ignoring election theft in plain sight.
The North Carolina state Supreme Court stepped in to stop the certification of the election for a justice on their court , which is a huge breach of power and a clearly partisan action in a state where judges are affiliated with political parties.
For background: On Election Day, incumbent Justice Allison Riggs (D) was reelected by a slim margin of a few hundred votes. Her disgruntled opponent, GOP Judge Jefferson Griffin, sued for and received two separate recounts -- both of which increased Riggs' lead.
Now Judge Griffin has sued to remove 60,000 voters' ballots from the count , even though they've been validated in the recount. The state Board of Elections dismissed his request , but now his partisan, would-be colleagues -- the court has a 5-2 Republican majority -- have stepped in to adjudicate the election and possibly kick off one of their own.
Justices Anita Earls (D) and Richard Dietz (R) dissented while Justice Riggs properly recused herself, so the judicial stay on election certification was put in place by a 4-2, mainly party-line vote.
The bottom line is that the partisan Supreme Court is stepping into an election for one of their own members to try and reverse the results of the vote because their party didn't win. Opponents of voting rights are trying to steal this election in plain sight.

**Good Morning Prince George’s!** This year is off to a tough start. As I meet with community members, it’s heartbreaking to see so many impacted by the current administration’s policies. Many residents—federal employees, contractors, military personnel, and those relying on federal funding—face uncertainty. Now more than ever, our county needs experienced leadership.As County Executive during the previous Trump administration, I tackled similar challenges:
* Closed a budget deficit without raising taxes by driving economic development.
* Increased school funding, expanded academic programs, and improved early childhood education.
* Strengthened communities through the Transforming Neighborhoods Initiative (TNI), cutting crime by 50% while securing grants to address local needs.

**My vision remains the same: a thriving economy, great schools, safe neighborhoods, and high-quality health care.** Leadership matters, and our county can’t afford a learning curve. That’s why I’m running again for Prince George's County Executive.Ballots are out—voting has begun. I need your support. Join Team Baker today!

clean_body: In uncertain times, we deserve leadership we can trust. That’s why I’ve decided to run for Prince George’s County Executive, again. | | | | | Good Morning Prince George’s! This year is off to a tough start. As I meet with community members, it’s heartbreaking to see so many impacted by the current administration’s policies. Many residents—federal employees, contractors, military personnel, and those relying on federal funding—face uncertainty. Now more than ever, our county needs experienced leadership.As County Executive during the previous Trump administration, I tackled similar challenges: Closed a budget deficit without raising taxes by driving economic development. Increased school funding, expanded academic programs, and improved early childhood education. Strengthened communities through the Transforming Neighborhoods Initiative (TNI), cutting crime by 50% while securing grants to address local needs. My vision remains the same: a thriving economy, great schools, safe neighborhoods, and high-quality health care.** Leadership matters, and our county can’t afford a learning curve. That’s why I’m running again for Prince George's County Executive.Ballots are out—voting has begun. I need your support. Join Team Baker today! Thank you for your support, | Rushern L. Hi Peter,
The state supreme court race in North Carolina isn’t going to be resolved any time soon. It’s time to prepare for what is shaping up to be a long fight for our democracy.
Back in November, Justice Allison Riggs won re-election. That was the result after all the votes were counted... and recounted... _and recounted again_. But her opponent is trying to convince a court to invalidate over 60,000 (legally valid) ballots — a brazen attempt to overturn a result he doesn’t like.
It’s mind-blowing that this challenge is even moving forward. And it’s the canary in the coal mine for democracy. No one should be able to throw out legal votes after the election is over, and no one should be able to grind our system to a halt and waste taxpayer dollars because they lost a free and fair election.

President Trump just disbanded a federal school safety board that *he* created after the Parkland shooting where 17 people died.
#

Friends,
President Trump has disbanded a federal school safety advisory board, which was created by Trump himself after the Parkland shooting where 17 people died. The goal of the advisory board was to help share resources and best practices related to school safety—an incredibly vital area of work, considering there were 330 shootings at schools in 2024.
Between this and his apparent dissolution of the federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention, it’s clear that President Trump is choosing the gun lobby over saving lives.
We’re hard at work urging the Trump Administration to reconstitute the federal school safety advisory board, and we need your help to fuel this critical effort.

body:
I ran for office three years ago. I don't think I'm going to do it again anytime soon. The challenges I see are contributing to a more polarized political environment.

# [It's really hard to run for political office](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=155936496&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU1OTM2NDk2LCJpYXQiOjE3MzgxNjg4NjcsImV4cCI6MTc0MDc2MDg2NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ePvlBXRxW4gUp1yaSrtHqPF1u6yEfemwohWTGjJWSpM)
### I ran for office three years ago. I don't think I'm going to do it again anytime soon. The challenges I see are contributing to a more polarized political environment.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Jan 29
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvYmVuc2FtdWVscy9wL2l0cy1yZWFsbHktaGFyZC10by1ydW4tZm9yLXBvbGl0aWNhbC1vZmZpY2U_.vMr4u39kuYXrYzvhxDbdpGDruTxmEx-YCPVmP917vRY?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)

---

_This post was originally sent to the newsletter of[WelcomePAC](https://substack.com/redirect/5f3dbe5b-d096-4936-9d39-da67864d7951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a community of centrist Democrats supporting candidates who can win swing voters, protect democracy, and govern effectively.
