body:
https://freedomva.org/ [https://freedomva.org/]
Another week of the 2025 Virginia General Assembly Session has come and gone! Last week was a busy one; we had two Advocacy Days, spoke to over 20 legislators about our affordability legislation, and testified in committees. Here’s a look at what we’ve supported and opposed last week:
Supported:
Freedom Virginia is committed to lowering the cost of medicine for hardworking people and ensuring that drug companies can’t get away with price gouging. Accordingly, we supported:
* HB 1724 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1724] (Prescription Drug Affordability Board)
* SB 875 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB875] (Single Medicaid PBM)
* SB 1215 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1306] (Prior Authorization)
Freedom Virginia believes no one should have to choose between their paycheck and the health of themselves or a loved one. Accordingly, we supported:
* SB 1122 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1122] (Paid Family & Medical Leave)
* HB 2531 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2531] (Paid Family and Medical Leave)
* HB 1921 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1921] (Paid Sick Leave)
Freedom Virginia believes big corporations should not be able to get away with deceptive practices that slam Virginians with hidden fees, costing them thousands each year. Accordingly, we supported:
* SB 1212 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1212] (Banning Hidden Fees)
* HB 2085 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2085] (Transparent Health Insurance Processing Fees)
* SB 1356 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1356] (No Processing Fees on Electronic Fund Transfers)
Freedom Virginia believes that to respond to our housing crisis, we must take bold action to greatly increase the supply of housing and lower the cost of rent or buying a home. Accordingly, we supported:
* SB 1178 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1178] (Faith in Housing)
* SB 923 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB923] (Allows Building of ADUs)
* SB 839 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB839] (Housing Near Jobs)
* SB 975 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB975] (Require Localities to Increase Housing Stock)
* HB 2641 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2641] (Require Localities to Increase Housing Stock)
* HB 1832 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1832] (Mandatory ADUs)
Freedom Virginia believes we need to support hardworking parents, especially those who want to go back to work or work more, by lowering the cost of child care. Accordingly, we supported:
* SB 756 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB756] (Childcare Funding Formula)
* HB 2538 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2538] (Child Care Funding Formula)
Freedom Virginia believes hardworking Virginians need to keep more of what they earn, whether it’s their own wages or the unnecessary fees charged by big corporations when they file their taxes. Accordingly, we supported:
* HB 1625 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB1625] (Raising Minimum Wage for Farm Workers)
* HB 2264 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HB2264] / SB 1306 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1306] (Virginia Joins IRS Free File)
Freedom Virginia is pleased to support three proposed constitutional amendments because we believe that everyday Virginians can’t have the freedom to thrive without the freedom to make their own reproductive health decisions, marry who they love, and exercise their right to vote. Accordingly, we supported:
* SJ 247 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SJ247] / HJ 1 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HJ1] (Reproductive Freedom Constitutional Amendment)
* SJ 249 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SJ249] / HJ 9 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HJ9] (Removing the Ban on Same Sex Marriage)
* SJ 248 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-search?q=eyJzZWxlY3RlZEJpbGxOdW1iZXJzIjoic2oyNDgiLCJzZWxlY3RlZEtleXdvcmRzIjoiIiwic2VsZWN0ZWRTZXNzaW9uIjo1N30=] / HJ 2 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/HJ2] (Automatic Restoration of Rights)
Opposed:
Freedom Virginia believes that to make our economy more fair and affordable, we have to restructure our tax code to ensure our revenue generation is more balanced towards corporations and the ultra-wealthy. It is simply wrong that while we have underfunded needs like affordable housing, affordable child care, and K-12 schools, we see millionaires pay the same tax rate as teachers. We believe that current efforts to expand predatory gaming are a distraction from this important work on tax fairness, and we accordingly opposed:
* SB 1323 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1323] (Skill Games)
* SB 982 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB982] (Tysons Casino)
Freedom Virginia believes that there are myriad causes of expensive drugs, but that the solution to lowering drug prices is not by making health insurance more expensive for everyone. Accordingly, we opposed:
* SB 1078 [https://lis.virginia.gov/bill-details/20251/SB1078] (Pharma Cost Share)
As the session continues, we will continue to advocate for an affordable Virginia!

Programs that feed children, help disaster victims, and fund firefighters, police officers, and hospitals. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: This is what a threat to democracy looks like
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Let’s be honest, it’s been a hell of a few weeks for the future of our democracy.
From executive orders that undermine constitutional rights to dangerous pardons that embolden extremists, we’ve seen a nonstop barrage of attacks on the very foundations of our government.
But one act stands out as a deliberate step to pave the way for unchecked power:
Trump fired at least 15 independent government watchdogs in the dead of night.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250129_ig_firing_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250129_ig_firing_image]
These inspectors general weren’t just bureaucrats—they were the safeguards of our democracy, tasked with rooting out corruption, waste, and abuse.
Their job was to investigate government agencies, prevent misconduct, and ensure accountability to the American people.
Now?
Trump has dismantled this safeguard, violating federal law in the process, all to install ULTRA-MAGA cronies who will look the other way.
We’re gearing up for the fight ahead, but we need your help to build a strong movement to counter this corruption. Will you chip in $25 today to stand with us? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250129_ig_firing_link1]
This isn’t draining the swamp; it’s turning it into a cesspool.
And let’s not forget Trump’s #1 enabler in all this: Jim Jordan.
Jordan isn’t just clapping from the sidelines—he’s actively working to dismantle the very systems meant to hold power accountable.
Under his leadership, the Judiciary Committee has wasted countless taxpayer dollars chasing wild conspiracy theories, from investigating political enemies to shielding corrupt allies.
Now, with these watchdogs gone, Jordan has the green light to let Trump’s cronies run rampant.
He’s not just ignoring the real issues facing Ohioans—he’s paving the way for an administration that prioritizes political revenge over working families, safety, and justice.
This is what Jim Jordan and Donald Trump stand for: chaos for the country and unchecked power for themselves.
This is the exact threat to democracy we feared, and it’s coming fast.
But here’s the thing: we’re not backing down.
We’re building a movement to take them on—not just in 2026, but right now.
Together, we can hold them accountable.
We're in the final stages of preparing a bold new initiative that will take this fight to the next level. Every dollar gets us closer to launching this game-changing effort, and we need you with us to make it happen. Will you chip in today to help us power this fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250129_ig_firing_link2]
Working for US,

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Trump and his billionaire backers have declared an all out War on Truth.
They’re coming after our independent media...eager to get it out of the way
so they can easily spread disinformation AND rake in billions by sending
us to the platforms they own to get our news.

“NO MORE FUNDING FOR NPR, A TOTAL SCAM!” Trump wrote on Truth Social. Musk
quickly followed suit, labeling public media as “propaganda” and outlining
clear plans to cut hundreds of millions in funding for the Corporation for
Public Broadcasting, which funds NPR and PBS.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21279?t=1011&akid=7603%2E5885482%2EB3YexX ][IMG]

With a $30 million budget shortfall that’s already forced NPR to lay off
staff, public media stations are not in a position to launch a massive
campaign to save themselves.

But we are.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21279?source=email-012925&t=1012&akid=7603%2E5885482%2EB3YexX ]Our Revolution is already hard at work mobilizing record breaking
numbers and unleashing a huge lobbying push on Congress. But to win this
fight, we’re going to need EVERYONE to join us. Will you send an urgent
message to Congress to save independent media from Trump?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21279?source=email-012925&t=1013&akid=7603%2E5885482%2EB3YexX ]ADD YOUR NAME

Republicans have been trying since the NIXON administration to kill NPR
and PBS – and we’ve stopped them every. single. time. But experts warn
that this time could be different.

Musk has made it crystal clear that public media is on the top of his list
for government cuts. And many Republicans are gleefully going along for
the ride. Marjorie Taylor Greene just threatened to summon PBS to testify
before her committee in Congress.

It’s a chilling and blatant attack on our free media. It’s not hard to
imagine what could be next – like an editorial ‘takeover’ to make these
the mouth-pieces of the administration.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21279?t=1014&akid=7603%2E5885482%2EB3YexX ][IMG]

It’s not just NPR and PBS. Last year, Trump filed a defamation case
against ABC. And instead of fighting back, ABC agreed to settle for a
shocking $16 million. Emboldened, Trump is now coming after other news
outlets when he doesn’t like their coverage.

As CNN’s Jim Acosta said this week: “It is never a good time to bow down
to a tyrant ... it’s the job of the press to hold power to account”.

This is the bold stance we must all hold in face of theseIt’s terrifying
attacks on a free press — but the good news is that Trump can’t carry this
out alone. To make the public media cuts a reality, Republicans will need
almost unanimous support in Congress. So we’re going to raise the
temperature to make sure they’re ALL hearing from thousands of
constituents to ensure that a ‘yes’ vote is a risk Congress members don’t
want to take.

It’s terrifying, but the good news is that Trump can’t do this alone. To
make the public media cuts a reality, Republicans will need almost
unanimous support in Congress. So we’re going to raise the temperature to
make sure they’re ALL hearing from thousands of constituents who believe
in a public media and ensure that a ‘yes’ vote is a risk Congress members
don’t want to take.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21279?source=email-012925&t=1015&akid=7603%2E5885482%2EB3YexX ]Let’s make this attack on PBS and NPR a line in the sand to show Trump
we will NOT let him bend our media to his will. Will you add your name to
send a message straight to Congress and save our media from Trump?

When we organize, we win.

| Peter,

I stand firmly opposed to the Trump administration’s mass deportations.

We need real immigration solutions that keep families together, protect Dreamers, and recognize the vital contributions immigrants make to our economy. We do not need more hateful rhetoric and xenophobic policies.

For those in our community in fear, I want to reiterate that no matter your immigration status, you have rights. The Immigrant Legal Resource Center has created red cards, [_**linked here**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101193982/525205279/-1645141099?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWQ4NGEyOC03ZGRlLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I_3fSClN1d5yB_R1nAZsamzx_hi0Hj0y9o6TCkzhphw=&emci=43955729-61de-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=c9d84a28-7dde-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=6681226), to help assert your rights in the face of an ICE raid.

—

Me opongo firmemente a las deportaciones masivas del Presidente Trump.

Ahora más que nunca, se requieren soluciones que mantengan a nuestras familias unidas, protejan a Dreamers, y reconozcan las contribuciones vitales de los inmigrantes a nuestra economía. No necesitamos más discursos de odio y politicas xenófobicas.

No importa tu estatus migratorio, TU tienes derechos. El Immigrant Legal Resource Center (Centro de Recursos Legales para Inmigrantes) se ha encargado de crear tarjetas rojas con información sobre tus derechos, en caso de una redada de ICE. Si gusta imprimirla y compartirla, [_**dirijase a este enlace.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101193983/525205281/-1645141099?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWQ4NGEyOC03ZGRlLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I_3fSClN1d5yB_R1nAZsamzx_hi0Hj0y9o6TCkzhphw=&emci=43955729-61de-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=c9d84a28-7dde-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=6681226)

Linda

We’re barely one month into the year, and Ohio Republicans are already proving they’ll do anything to push their extreme agenda. If you thought 2025 might bring a change of heart—think again.

Before we dive into their “accomplishments” this month, [_**we’re asking if you can chip in $1, $5, or anything you can afford to help us organize, mobilize, and hold them accountable for the damage they’re doing to our state >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/101194186/525205928/1223462587?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_EOM_250129_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNmMzMDBkZS03ZGRlLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LMzvTw_k_GsI4rPqrHUbF3_HKK0RBke6jbjHQmpgTx8=)

Their latest move? Ohio Senators Jon Husted and Bernie Moreno voted to confirm Pete Hegseth, Trump’s nominee for Secretary of Defense—who has been trailed by an ever-growing list of disturbing allegations. Husted and Moreno would rather prioritize blind obedience to a president who doesn’t care about Ohioans than do their jobs.

Attorney General Dave Yost, who leads the Ohio GOP for putting extreme policies first and Ohioans last, officially announced his run for Governor of Ohio.

_And_ Trump ally Vivek Ramaswamy—another unaccountable self-enriching GOP politician—teased that he too, will run for Governor of Ohio.

Ohio Republicans are using every tool at their disposal to cling to power and silence the voices of everyday Ohioans. They’re showing us exactly whose side they’re on. And it’s not yours.

Serving on the powerful **Transportation & Infrastructure Committee** will allow me to continue my effective leadership from my time as Assembly Chair of the Transportation Committee, where I pushed for forward-thinking investments to make our transportation policies more equitable and sustainable. I’m excited to hold lawmakers in Washington accountable, and to be able to fight to bring federal dollars into California. We sent an unmistakable message yesterday. Now, let’s keep up the pressure.
#
Peter — back last November, right after Trump was elected and we faced down total Republican control of the government, we told you something.
We told you that even now, even in the minority, even as Trump’s administration readies an all out assault on everything we hold dear, we are not out of the fight.
We still have agency. We still have our voices. We still have each other. And when we bring those assets to bear, we’re a force to be reckoned with.
Yesterday, we rallied all of our supporters and all of our allies to stop Trump’s freeze on federal spending. We said, with one voice, that we will not stand by as the Trump administration rips care, benefits, and support away from Veterans, their families, and everyday Americans across this country.
Today, this happened:

They revoked the memo.
This victory tells us that when enough of us come together, we can beat them.

body:
Please read the following message.
* * *

| | | | | [](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5I9ITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)

Friend, Elon Musk made a bold (and expensive) move to buy Twitter after seeing the tech giant de-platform The Babylon Bee simply for telling a joke.While Elon joined The Bee in launching a revolution for free speech, X stood alone in rejecting unquestioning conformity. Censorship remained king on virtually every other social media platform, including Facebook. Despite the woke left's best efforts to silence The Babylon Bee, we haven't feared retribution from advertisers or being 'canceled' by woke social media platforms** because we have freedom-loving Americans like you who support our work.** **[**Subscribers are the backbone of The Babylon Bee, which allows us to battle for freedom of thought, the exchange of ideas, and truth. Your support as a member will allow us to continue creating satirical content and fighting for free speech.**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IaITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)**
---
[](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IbITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)
---

---
Given Facebook's history of suppressing dissent, it was a huge surprise when Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Facebook and Meta recently outed the Biden administration for demanding his platform censor opposing viewpoints.Appearing on Joe Rogan's podcast, Zuckerberg said:
---
_** "These people from the Biden administration would call up our team and, like, scream at them and curse**... Basically, it just got to this point where we were like, no, we're not going to take down things that are true... We just said, no, we're not going to take down humor and **satire**."_
---
**I wouldn 't be surprised if Biden's lackeys called up Twitter and demanded they silence The Babylon Bee** after we told a joke about Rachel Levine -- Biden's U.S. assistant secretary for health. It seems satirical that a website that got its start with church humor garnered national attention for telling a joke--but it's true, and it catapulted us into the national conversation on free speech. **[As a subscriber, you can help The Babylon Bee keep delivering fake news you can trust-- no matter what pressures we face from woke, anti-freedom activists.](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IdITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)**
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IeITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)
---
Given what Mark Zuckerberg shared with Joe Rogan, it seems it was common practice for Biden's team to call up social media companies and demand they remove content the administration didn't like.We certainly didn't buy ourselves any favors with headlines including, "_Joe Biden found in dumpster behind DNC Convention Center " _and _" Joe Biden praised for historic rescue efforts to save kid he pushed down a well."_But, this is America, we value freedom, and we aren't going to apologize for writing satire. **Sorry, not sorry, Joe.** Even with Biden out the door, Trump in the White House, X leading Big Tech in its allegiance to free speech, and Facebook making strides to curb its suppression of thought ... _the censorship machine hasn 't dissolved_. **[**As the free speech war wages us, please help The Babylon Bee stand on the right side of history. Join as a member today.**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IfITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee ](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xueb2hIteknop5IgITm6ins0je&s=DBCHHGJGOBBKCHMH)
---
Thanks for supporting free speech. **We 'll never give up the fight.** Seth DillonCEO, The Babylon Bee

body:
We deserve a Health Secretary who is serious about taking on gun violence.
#

Friends,
During his first Senate confirmation hearing today, RFK Jr.—Trump’s pick for Secretary of Health and Human Services—refused again and again to back off his assertion that antidepressants cause school shootings, despite data proving that’s not true.
This reckless and baseless claim stigmatizes people struggling with mental health while avoiding the real cause of America’s gun violence crisis:
**_The guns._**
We deserve a Health Secretary who is serious about taking on gun violence. After all, it is a public health crisis.
We can assure you: RFK Jr. is not the guy for the job.
[**We’re fighting back to make sure RFK Jr. isn’t confirmed to lead the Department of Health and Human Services. name: Mazie Hirono
subject: Happy Lunar New Year, Peter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mazie Hirono For Hawaii**
body:
|
#
---
Aloha Peter, This Lunar New Year we welcome the Year of the Snake — a complex symbol of creativity and determination. In Hawaii, the Lunar New Year has always been a great celebration to ring in a new year and celebrate cultures that have helped shape Hawaii and the rest of the country we call home. Community activities and cultural performances like street fairs, lion dances, and parades will help celebrate new beginnings and the hope for a happy and prosperous Year of the Snake. body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4576%2E35263%2Envhlx1 ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter, less
than 10 days into the job, Donald Trump is sending the entire country into
a tailspin.

Late Monday night, Trump ordered a freeze on all federal grants and loans.
That left millions of Americans wondering if they would receive health
care through Medicaid, if their children would get school lunches, if
police and fire departments should stop hiring, or if farmers would get
desperately needed aid.

I promise you,
Peter, that I am doing all that I
can to fight back and get the funding Wisconsin needs and deserves.

I’ve heard from countless constituents worried about the impacts of
Trump’s callous actions. And after a series of contradictory
communications from the Trump Administration this morning, the American
people are left even more confused about how they will be impacted.

While the Trump Administration sows chaos, confusion, and panic, I’m
working with my colleagues to fight back and restore the funding that
these vital programs and agencies need.

My team and I will keep you updated,
Peter. I know these uncertain
times can be scary, and I’m here to do all I can to help you and your
family.

Thank you,

Tammy

| | That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom**.

_**[People often ask...how did I get that name?](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=46168f1fb5e34a0493947ab722ed0250&_e=6DnQ0FJEsTQf7BbuS_LMec_EvlJOA53VugZuqxvW3lmGXv_V-DdgwUzlwqZl3x2GloKDlCj_X00bYmpHiAZ2QU2li0iYWIVMrFid4d8MejzvMZdlsHTHHYG-t7R9XvrPLGn_hPmLiIWfE4GQpQ44aVy_vBsy8TK-akSszQlh8C0bIlkwDfYLUizRkV9JuWB2vKVxRkU5n60JtgurvBTWbAoWi0ktvGMs0SAcH1tg1mBqaLrcFSyg9gK_dN22JGRkIdFU0ChnPHYcNMS4OcvVG_9zbi7uPMVp7cVdZZtVPMO1Pt4Oum8bd1AZmmr3in9iQinwn_NnQYnTRQH6qeico7-afMmUT41MOzl6SP0_t4A6XupaAYG6cBxAMCPjDwV3VlUBHZSlZQIKtG72okFKLbMlTIX_ES4fmT74VtS4-BM52K7spUSAVm5HaM6tC3iS)**_

Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.

There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.

Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!

_It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me**the importance of service. **_

Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to **SERVE**. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service.

As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.

**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about _service_.**

_Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. _

No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C.

If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, [**I 'm asking you to send me some help today.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=46168f1fb5e34a0493947ab722ed0250&_e=6DnQ0FJEsTQf7BbuS_LMec_EvlJOA53VugZuqxvW3lmGXv_V-DdgwUzlwqZl3x2GloKDlCj_X00bYmpHiAZ2QU2li0iYWIVMrFid4d8MejzvMZdlsHTHHYG-t7R9XvrPLGn_hPmLiIWfE4GQpQ44aVy_vBsy8TK-akSszQlh8C0bIlkwDfYLUizRkV9JuWB2vKVxRkU5n60JtgurvBTWbAoWi0ktvGMs0SAcH1tg1mBqaLrcFSyg9gK_dN22JGRkIdFU0ChnPHYcNMS4OcvVG0WN-K2QVizCCArAI-UDCZ1Cm5S2EhGhdOhbVvg3WrXcq9aDQ82KQiO1ZE7-uHjS-hcrqCtWEmQLSnGDfqEvQAhUusOo-wQQFgeaaYfq9mYUw6J8k2Apilmg8iNHPeWPFeGTaTagGOy-b4ocN4KqcQx-kCSXIiMoZxkAAI0On3K0)

clean_body: It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service. | | | | | That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...Blossom. Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets. There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets. Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story! It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in methe importance of service. Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service. As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community. While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about service. Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C. If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, Because I'm a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to support my fight against the Democrats. | | | | I know this was a longer message than you are probably used to getting, but I want you to know where I'm coming from and why I need your help. Whether it's $100 or just $10, anything you can contribute will help this Navy veteran keep fighting back business as usual in D.C. It's time we support leaders who truly want to serve our country, and that's what I promise to always do...are you with me, Fellow Patriot? With the courage to fight, | | | | -Jen | | I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger. Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America's success! | | | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress USE OF MILITARY IMAGES OR RANK DOES NOT IMPLY ENDORSEMENT BY THE U.S. DEPT. | Dear Hello There are thousands of bills that the Virginia Senate must review, debate, discuss and vote on. They have until Saturday, February 22 to complete all of their work.
I've chosen to highlight a handful of bills that I found interesting. If you would like to review the complete list of bills coming up in each committee, simply click below on the name of the committee. You will find the full list along with the full description of each bill.
You can look up a particular bill, find a bill's status, all by using the links below.
Please keep in mind that I'm only following the work coming before the Virginia Senate. Bills that pass the House will also be heard by the Senate after Crossover.
Today, I want to highlight 2 Republicans.
Kudos to Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears for casting the tie vote against Democrat Senator Hashmi's deceptive bill, [SB1105](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Imn52B_QI92xXq4YFFhxJogdSmMLhCeHVvKmLF7vFQvR1a-HrINJzCTSRtQd3tzIURQiPLiCRJsAAceml15uTAAv7kbTTQafRRTc-OneLDoz94dmVdE_q4FYw0cU4NrGIrW58NZ6h-l2sHdSW84nIXx0CUA25lOLsH-0cQsFEBQzGfsCDaGkLDDfPvKaMkA-&c=2vO0sXPvASCYfWbpiqNAcwtXztfBSTIYgHShv_GQCIfskVta4nID-g==&ch=-U7EL4cRgmMq62JnDnwGWLTn-dbHDIMg2pCupNrjtmUHPbRGbs6o5A==), which Democrats are calling, the "Contraception Bill."
For those of us who are pro-life, it's a signal to voters that she supports the unborn and isn't afraid to go on the record for life. Thank you, Lieutenant Governor Sears.
According to Democrats, this was a parliamentary trick the "baby killing" Democrats, used to put the LG on the record for life. The deceptive Democrats want to mislead people and misrepresent the truth. They will say the LG is against contraception, instead of owning up to the true purpose of this bill- abortion on demand.
Those of us who support life, appreciate the Lieutenant Governor's vote against the bill.
Once the bill failed, thanks to the LG's prolife vote, the Democrats "reconsidered the vote," and the bill passed on a party line vote 21 to 18, with Republican Senator French not voting.
Notice it's always the Democrats introducing abortion bills.
While Democrats spin this as "a woman's right to contraception, it doesn't mention the penalties and legal action against anyone who deprives an individual of contraception, to include the Morning After pill, also called Plan B.
SB1105 states in the bill text: "The attorney general may commence a civil action on behalf of the state against any person that violates or enforces a law, regulation, or policy that violates the provisions of this chapter."
Talk about extreme. Essentially, Democrats are saying, let us use abortion as a form of birth control or we're going to sue you. This is crazy.
Most Republican legislators support contraception, that doesn't kill the baby. We support preventing unwanted pregnancies.
But we do not support abortion as a form of birth control.
Women have the right to do what they want to do with their own body, including making a decision about health, but that right does not trump the Constitutional rights of a helpless baby, who can't speak for itself.
Today's Democrats support killing newborns. Their legislation speaks for itself.
They promote a culture of irresponsibility and promote using abortion as an acceptable method of birth control.
lnstead they want to mandate their reckless agenda on others who do not agree with them and attempt to silence them by going after them financially. The Commonwealth shouldn't be rewarding bad behavior.
A society that kills its children cannot prosper.
I also wanted to address high electric bills. While it has been unusually cold, many of us are experiencing higher than usual electric bills. My energy bill last month was $850, and this past month $550.
Heating one's home has become unaffordable. So I appreciate Republican Senator Travis Hackworth, my former seat mate, for trying to do something about it.
Monday, The AEP Accountability Act, SB1281 sponsored by Republican Senator Travis Hackworth a failed 8 to 7 (passed by indefinitely) in the Commerce and Labor Committee.
This bill was touted as an electric utilities proposal that would have allowed AEP customers greater freedom to choose service providers.
Watch Senator Hackworth present the bill [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Imn52B_QI92xXq4YFFhxJogdSmMLhCeHVvKmLF7vFQvR1a-HrINJzHsHxdST2oWzeOlIRjCZROzjyMB3e7QaV7_9Qitm2YAFKCm_4kCyPQp2NSrNDdNwDGS-R-1RYRaOfWwoVDYGBiHyBbxEQ7g1odaa3McMzQ1nsdRm2la2A6HQqFjAGVWahSYxeOS-Brww-q3To2zhZl6tlOQjKzKlpQ==&c=2vO0sXPvASCYfWbpiqNAcwtXztfBSTIYgHShv_GQCIfskVta4nID-g==&ch=-U7EL4cRgmMq62JnDnwGWLTn-dbHDIMg2pCupNrjtmUHPbRGbs6o5A==). Start at 23:00.

As we draw closer to Crossover, some committees who have finished their dockets, will not meet until after Crossover.
All Senate bills must be heard in committee before next Tuesday at midnight. So tomorrow, you will see that some committee have finished their work and have cancelled their committee meeting for the week.
Please keep in mind that you can actually call in, while the legislators are conducting their committee meeting, and voice whether you support or oppose a bill and why. Just click on the link below to "watch" a committee, and there are instructions on how to participate live.
Of course you are always welcome to make public comment live, but many like the convenience of participating on line.
I've enjoyed your daily comments, suggestions and questions. I will do my best to answer them within 24 hours.
In general, any questions you may have about federal issues like immigration, social security, the postal service, federal highways or veteran benefits are questions you will want to reach out to your US Congressman or US Senator.
State Senators handle any state issue like workman's compensation, unemployment benefits or issues involving state agencies.
I appreciate all of your questions and will do my best to respond in a timely manner.
Thank you for caring about your state government and doing your part.
God bless you.

| In the Virginia Senate, each bill has three Constitutional reads. Only bills on the third read and are on the "regular calendar" are debated.
Bills that are on the "uncontested calendar," are bills that all Democrat and Republican Senators gave a thumbs up. So, when the bill comes to the Senator floor from the committee, unless a Senator pulls the bill out of the block, the bill is not debated on the floor and is simply voted on in a block.
As a Senator, I always reviewed the bills on third read on the uncontested calendar and many times would pull a bill out of the block, to hear the patron present the bill, to ensure I was in agreement with the members of the committee.
I've only highlighted bills on the third read for your convenience.
---

clean_body: The 2025 General Assembly Session | | | | 2025 THE HONEY BADGER REPORT | | | 2025 SESSION Thursday What can you expect? | | ATTEND IN PERSON OR CALL IN TO THE MEETING LIVE | Thursday Senate Committee Meetings | FINANCE & APPROPRIATIONS Subcommittee on Health & Human Resources 7:30 AM, Thursday Senate Finance & Appropriations Room, 13th floor, GAB EDUCATION & HEALTH 8:30 AM, Thursday Senate Room A (305), GAB SESSION Noon, Thursday Senate Chamber, Capitol TRANSPORTATION 15 min after session adjourns, Thursday Senate Room B (306), GAB EDUCATION & HEALTH Subcommittee on Public Education 30 min after session adjourns, Thursday Senate Room C , GAB FINANCE & APPROPRIATIONS Subcommittee on Education 3:00 PM, Thursday Senate Finance & Appropriations Room, 13th Floor, GAB FINANCE & APPROPRIATIONS Subcommittee on Resources 4:00 PM, Thursday Senate Finance & Appropriations Room, 13th Floor, GAB | AMANDA CHASE | VIRGINIA'S HONEY BADGER | Dear Hello There are thousands of bills that the Virginia Senate must review, debate, discuss and vote on. They have until Saturday, February 22 to complete all of their work. I've chosen to highlight a handful of bills that I found interesting. If you would like to review the complete list of bills coming up in each committee, simply click below on the name of the committee. You will find the full list along with the full description of each bill. You can look up a particular bill, find a bill's status, all by using the links below. Please keep in mind that I'm only following the work coming before the Virginia Senate. Bills that pass the House will also be heard by the Senate after Crossover. Today, I want to highlight 2 Republicans. Kudos to Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears for casting the tie vote against Democrat Senator Hashmi's deceptive bill, ==, which Democrats are calling, the "Contraception Bill." For those of us who are pro-life, it's a signal to voters that she supports the unborn and isn't afraid to go on the record for life. Thank you, Lieutenant Governor Sears. According to Democrats, this was a parliamentary trick the "baby killing" Democrats, used to put the LG on the record for life. The deceptive Democrats want to mislead people and misrepresent the truth. They will say the LG is against contraception, instead of owning up to the true purpose of this bill- abortion on demand. Those of us who support life, appreciate the Lieutenant Governor's vote against the bill. Once the bill failed, thanks to the LG's prolife vote, the Democrats "reconsidered the vote," and the bill passed on a party line vote 21 to 18, with Republican Senator French not voting. Notice it's always the Democrats introducing abortion bills. While Democrats spin this as "a woman's right to contraception, it doesn't mention the penalties and legal action against anyone who deprives an individual of contraception, to include the Morning After pill, also called Plan B. SB1105 states in the bill text: "The attorney general may commence a civil action on behalf of the state against any person that violates or enforces a law, regulation, or policy that violates the provisions of this chapter." Talk about extreme. Essentially, Democrats are saying, let us use abortion as a form of birth control or we're going to sue you. This is crazy. Most Republican legislators support contraception, that doesn't kill the baby. We support preventing unwanted pregnancies. But we do not support abortion as a form of birth control. Women have the right to do what they want to do with their own body, including making a decision about health, but that right does not trump the Constitutional rights of a helpless baby, who can't speak for itself. Today's Democrats support killing newborns. Their legislation speaks for itself. They promote a culture of irresponsibility and promote using abortion as an acceptable method of birth control. lnstead they want to mandate their reckless agenda on others who do not agree with them and attempt to silence them by going after them financially. The Commonwealth shouldn't be rewarding bad behavior. A society that kills its children cannot prosper. I also wanted to address high electric bills. While it has been unusually cold, many of us are experiencing higher than usual electric bills. My energy bill last month was $850, and this past month $550. Heating one's home has become unaffordable. So I appreciate Republican Senator Travis Hackworth, my former seat mate, for trying to do something about it. Monday, The AEP Accountability Act, SB1281 sponsored by Republican Senator Travis Hackworth a failed 8 to 7 (passed by indefinitely) in the Commerce and Labor Committee. This bill was touted as an electric utilities proposal that would have allowed AEP customers greater freedom to choose service providers. Watch Senator Hackworth present the bill ==. Start at 23:00. | | As we draw closer to Crossover, some committees who have finished their dockets, will not meet until after Crossover. All Senate bills must be heard in committee before next Tuesday at midnight. So tomorrow, you will see that some committee have finished their work and have cancelled their committee meeting for the week. Please keep in mind that you can actually call in, while the legislators are conducting their committee meeting, and voice whether you support or oppose a bill and why. Just click on the link below to "watch" a committee, and there are instructions on how to participate live. Of course you are always welcome to make public comment live, but many like the convenience of participating on line. I've enjoyed your daily comments, suggestions and questions. I will do my best to answer them within 24 hours. In general, any questions you may have about federal issues like immigration, social security, the postal service, federal highways or veteran benefits are questions you will want to reach out to your US Congressman or US Senator. State Senators handle any state issue like workman's compensation, unemployment benefits or issues involving state agencies. I appreciate all of your questions and will do my best to respond in a timely manner. Thank you for caring about your state government and doing your part. God bless you. | BILLS TO WATCH BY COMMITTEE FOR A FULL BILL LISTING AND DETAIL CLICK THE COMMITTEE TAB | == == == == | | | == == == | | | | | | | | | | | == == == | In the Virginia Senate, each bill has three Constitutional reads. Only bills on the third read and are on the "regular calendar" are debated. Bills that are on the "uncontested calendar," are bills that all Democrat and Republican Senators gave a thumbs up. So, when the bill comes to the Senator floor from the committee, unless a Senator pulls the bill out of the block, the bill is not debated on the floor and is simply voted on in a block. As a Senator, I always reviewed the bills on third read on the uncontested calendar and many times would pull a bill out of the block, to hear the patron present the bill, to ensure I was in agreement with the members of the committee. I've only highlighted bills on the third read for your convenience. | | | == == == | | | | | | | == == == == | NO AGENDA POSTED | == == == == | | | == == == == | NO AGENDA POSTED | | | | | | | | | IMPORTANT DATES | 2025 LEGISLATIVE SESSION IMPORTANT DATES Begins: Wednesday, January 8 at noon Crossover: Tuesday, February 4 Ends: Saturday, February 22 Last Day for Governor's Actions: Monday, March 24 Reconvene: Wednesday, April 2 | IMPORTANT LINKS | | == | | == | | == | == | | == | SUPPORT AMANDA HERE | While this publication is free, your contributions are greatly appreciated. I served 8 years in the Virginia Senate from 2016-2023 and want to put that experience and knowledge to work for you. I know how things really work in Richmond and I want you to know too, so that you can hold your elected representatives accountable. A huge thanks to those of you who have already chipped in. Thank you. We must now save Virginia. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: He’s out for the billionaires, not you
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
All Trump cares about are his VIPs — the most ridiculously wealthy people on the planet. His top priority is getting them a massive tax cut while everything gets more expensive for the rest of us.
#

Peter —
When I was sworn in to the United States Senate, these were my VIPs:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250129-1-90&t=1&akid=3684%2E734936%2Ex0e8Ws)
My high school librarian.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250129-1-90&t=2&akid=3684%2E734936%2Ex0e8Ws)
My boss from the hot dog stand I worked at in high school.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250129-1-90&t=3&akid=3684%2E734936%2Ex0e8Ws)
The Marines I fought with in Iraq.
Those are the people I wanted with me to celebrate that milestone. They’re the people who helped me get here, and they’re people I got into public service for in the first place.
Now, when Trump took his oath of office, these were his VIPs:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250129-1-90&t=4&akid=3684%2E734936%2Ex0e8Ws)
Their combined net worth is nearly a trillion dollars, and they had the best seats in the house. It says a lot.
All Trump cares about are his VIPs: the most ridiculously wealthy people on the planet. His top priority is getting them a massive tax cut while everything gets more expensive for the rest of us.
When I head to work in the morning, the people I’m fighting for are my VIPs: the middle class and working families. It’s harder than ever for these people to make ends meet, and it’s only getting worse. People are struggling, and they’re tired of being let down.
It’s my job for the next six years to deliver for them. And it’s our job — all of us — to show that Trump’s not going to lift a finger to help anybody living paycheck-to-paycheck. He’s all in with the billionaires.
We’re going to work around the clock to deliver that message, but I can’t do this without you.
[**Peter, let’s continue what we started together when I launched my campaign two years ago. Make a donation and help me keep up the fight for the folks who really need it.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-jan25.N6iRGd&refcode=em250129-1-90&t=5&akid=3684%2E734936%2Ex0e8Ws)

Fellow Conservative,

_**American leadership is back.**_

**I can’t lie** \- watching officials in the former administration sit on their hands and run our country into the ground was painful, which is why it’s all the more refreshing to see President Trump unapologetically put America first.

Our allies and enemies alike understand that President Trump didn’t run to enrich himself or spend his days playing political games; he ran for office to make America great once again, and that’s precisely what he’s doing.

The proof?

Hamas, facing complete and total annihilation, swiftly agreed to a ceasefire deal to release the hostages before Trump was even sworn into office. Then, on Sunday, President Trump took the far-left president of Colombia (a former terrorist) to task for turning away two U.S. Air Force planes carrying illegal migrants from his country.

Hi Peter,
My name is Devon Moody, and I’m honored to serve as the Director of Politivist Action PAC — an organization inspired by the bold leadership and unwavering commitment of Cori Bush. Would you consider making a donation today to help Cori hit the ground running and build the strong foundation our organization needs? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1-politivistvideo?refcode=em_250129_Launch2_act&refcode2=x_012925_launch2]
From standing on the frontlines in Ferguson to making history as the first Black woman to represent Missouri in Congress, Cori has redefined what it means to lead with courage and conviction. Now, with the launch of Politivist Action PAC, she’s taking her vision for transformational change to the next level.
Cori calls herself a politivist — a term she coined to describe the powerful union of politician and activist. The activist listens, stands with the people, and moves boldly where others hesitate. The politician holds the pen, wields the power of the purse, and turns grassroots energy into transformative policy. Together, these roles create a leader who not only hears the needs of the people but also acts decisively to meet them. You can hear Cori speak more about what it means to be a politivist here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1-politivistvideo?refcode=em_250129_Launch2_act_a&refcode2=x_012925_launch2] in her interview on the Late Show with Stephen Colbert.

Politivist Action PAC is built on this principle: the fight for justice demands both activism and political action. Our mission is to elect and support bold, grassroots leaders who reject corporate influence and tirelessly fight for peace, justice, and human rights for all. We are here to confront extremism, defend democracy, and advance racial, economic, and social justice.
And look, Peter: this isn’t just about politics — it’s about building a movement that centers people over profit. A movement that combines the courage of activism with the power of policy-making. To put it bluntly, Trump has now officially entered office, and we have to do everything we can to reject his administration’s efforts to roll back all the progress we’ve made. But we can’t do this without your support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1-politivistvideo?refcode=em_250129_Launch2_act&refcode2=x_012925_launch2]

Together, we can empower leaders who will transform our communities and ensure our government reflects the needs of the people.
Thank you, and onward,
Devon Moody

John will work with Trump where he can to get wins for PA, but he’ll *always* fight to stop actions like this.
#
Derek, yesterday the Trump administration tried to freeze federal grants, and dozens of PA organizations — serving both 🔴 ➕ 🔵 low-income families — reached out to John’s office with concerns their funding would be cut off.
And with reports that PA’s Medicaid portal was also offline, **John called for Trump to restore services immediately:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250129?refcode=em20250129-9843&refcode2=9843_434096_LSoq5W&akid=9843%2E434096%2ELSoq5W)
**It looks like all the outrage had an effect, because today the White House just backed down:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250129?refcode=em20250129-9843&refcode2=9843_434096_LSoq5W&akid=9843%2E434096%2ELSoq5W)
John will work with Trump where he can to get wins for PA, but he’ll *always* fight to stop actions like this that would harm working folks across the country.
[**And Derek, he can’t do it without you! Will you pitch in before Friday’s end-of-month deadline to help us reach our $30,000 goal and keep this seat 🔵?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250129?refcode=em20250129-9843&refcode2=9843_434096_LSoq5W&akid=9843%2E434096%2ELSoq5W)

Friend, This week, the new presidential administration threw millions more people’s lives into chaos, attacking all of our communities by trying to pause federal funding that had already been allocated by Congress for a slew of essential programs. They also directed federal workers to resign if they disagree with Trump’s political views. We need bold leadership at every level of government to protect our communities and resist each of Trump’s attacks. **Thanks to pushback and legal challenges from government officials and organizations around the country, today the Trump administration rescinded its unconstitutional order for a federal funding freeze.** However, we know that the administration will come back with less sweeping, more targeted cuts to programs that Congress already allocated funding for, which could impact states, cities, service providers, and school districts across the country that rely on federal funding. We must stay vigilant and push back on further attacks on essential programs like food stamps, Meals on Wheels, and Medicaid. **I want to let you know that I see you, and I’m fighting for you. Let’s remember that this is the authoritarian playbook: sowing panic and hate to divide us from one another so they can distract us while they consolidate power and enrich the billionaire class.** They’re trying to overwhelm us and bring us into despair, all while most Americans are already living paycheck to paycheck—with many workers living on starvation wages and drowning just trying to make ends meet. **I will do everything in my power to fight back against Trump’s attacks** , including his unconstitutional attempt to undermine birthright citizenship. To make it clear: There is no doubt that if you are born in the U.S. you are a U.S. citizen; the president does not have the authority to change that. With the exception of people who were forced here in chains and the people who are Native to these lands, this is a country of immigrants. I wouldn’t be here in Congress if my parents hadn’t been able to immigrate and find work in the United States, and now I have the honor of representing a vibrantly diverse district with many immigrant families. This morning I joined local elected leaders and advocates at a press conference to inform our immigrant neighbors of their constitutional rights and to help other community members understand how we can best protect our loved ones. It’s up to all of us to resist dehumanization and to speak out so this administration’s racist and transphobic attacks are not normalized. We can’t let people in power pick and choose who they think should be Americans, or who they think should be human beings. **We know that we all belong here and we all deserve dignity and safety, and we can lift up our shared humanity in our communities. Please reach out to your loved ones and hold each other close.** We need each other for emotional support and for mutual aid—if you can afford to, now is the time to donate what you can to your local mutual aid groups and food banks. But we shouldn’t have to rely on mutual aid and crowdfunding in order to survive. **Together, we must continue demanding a functioning government that actually meets people’s needs.** Through our tax dollars, the federal government has the money to feed and house everyone, to provide universal healthcare and utilities for all, to ensure that each family can access clean water, and more. It’s through people power that we’ll push our government to shift its priorities from funding war and boosting corporate profits to investing in life. For this 119th session of Congress, **I was appointed to continue serving on the House Oversight and Reform Committee, where I will push Congress to exercise its oversight authority to stop Trump’s illegal power grabs**. It’s part of our constitutional duty as members of Congress to maintain the separation of co-equal powers between legislative and executive branches of government. **I’m also returning to the House Financial Services Committee, where I will keep fighting for working families, taking on corporate greed, and resisting harmful policies that prioritize tax cuts for billionaires over essential programs**. And in my elected role as Vice Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, I will continue growing the power of our movement for a future with equity and justice for all. As always, we get free together by working across differences toward the aim of a society where every single one of us can thrive as our full selves. We have the power to shift oppressive institutions; in fact, strong social movements have brought about every transformative change in this country. We didn’t get the _Civil Rights Act_ or the DACA program for undocumented youth or the right to form a union because people in the White House or Congress woke up one day and decided to do the right thing. Unfortunately we have to keep pushing to defend our wins, but we know that people power has won progress in hostile times by outworking the hate and organizing together on multiple fronts. We won’t stop now. Always fighting for you, Rashida

clean_body: We all belong here and we all deserve dignity and safety. | | | Friend, This week, the new presidential administration threw millions more people’s lives into chaos, attacking all of our communities by trying to pause federal funding that had already been allocated by Congress for a slew of essential programs. They also directed federal workers to resign if they disagree with Trump’s political views. We need bold leadership at every level of government to protect our communities and resist each of Trump’s attacks. Thanks to pushback and legal challenges from government officials and organizations around the country, today the Trump administration rescinded its unconstitutional order for a federal funding freeze. However, we know that the administration will come back with less sweeping, more targeted cuts to programs that Congress already allocated funding for, which could impact states, cities, service providers, and school districts across the country that rely on federal funding. We must stay vigilant and push back on further attacks on essential programs like food stamps, Meals on Wheels, and Medicaid. I want to let you know that I see you, and I’m fighting for you. Let’s remember that this is the authoritarian playbook: sowing panic and hate to divide us from one another so they can distract us while they consolidate power and enrich the billionaire class. They’re trying to overwhelm us and bring us into despair, all while most Americans are already living paycheck to paycheck—with many workers living on starvation wages and drowning just trying to make ends meet. I will do everything in my power to fight back against Trump’s attacks , including his unconstitutional attempt to undermine birthright citizenship. To make it clear: There is no doubt that if you are born in the U.S. you are a U.S. citizen; the president does not have the authority to change that. With the exception of people who were forced here in chains and the people who are Native to these lands, this is a country of immigrants. I wouldn’t be here in Congress if my parents hadn’t been able to immigrate and find work in the United States, and now I have the honor of representing a vibrantly diverse district with many immigrant families. This morning I joined local elected leaders and advocates at a press conference to inform our immigrant neighbors of their constitutional rights and to help other community members understand how we can best protect our loved ones. It’s up to all of us to resist dehumanization and to speak out so this administration’s racist and transphobic attacks are not normalized. We can’t let people in power pick and choose who they think should be Americans, or who they think should be human beings. We know that we all belong here and we all deserve dignity and safety, and we can lift up our shared humanity in our communities. Please reach out to your loved ones and hold each other close. We need each other for emotional support and for mutual aid—if you can afford to, now is the time to donate what you can to your local mutual aid groups and food banks. But we shouldn’t have to rely on mutual aid and crowdfunding in order to survive. Together, we must continue demanding a functioning government that actually meets people’s needs. Through our tax dollars, the federal government has the money to feed and house everyone, to provide universal healthcare and utilities for all, to ensure that each family can access clean water, and more. It’s through people power that we’ll push our government to shift its priorities from funding war and boosting corporate profits to investing in life. For this 119th session of Congress, I was appointed to continue serving on the House Oversight and Reform Committee, where I will push Congress to exercise its oversight authority to stop Trump’s illegal power grabs. It’s part of our constitutional duty as members of Congress to maintain the separation of co-equal powers between legislative and executive branches of government. I’m also returning to the House Financial Services Committee, where I will keep fighting for working families, taking on corporate greed, and resisting harmful policies that prioritize tax cuts for billionaires over essential programs. And in my elected role as Vice Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, I will continue growing the power of our movement for a future with equity and justice for all. As always, we get free together by working across differences toward the aim of a society where every single one of us can thrive as our full selves. We have the power to shift oppressive institutions; in fact, strong social movements have brought about every transformative change in this country. We didn’t get the Civil Rights Act or the DACA program for undocumented youth or the right to form a union because people in the White House or Congress woke up one day and decided to do the right thing. Unfortunately we have to keep pushing to defend our wins, but we know that people power has won progress in hostile times by outworking the hate and organizing together on multiple fronts. We won’t stop now. Always fighting for you, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . President Donald Trump **[met with Allyson Phillips, the mother of slain nursing student Laken Riley,](https://substack.com/redirect/b50ae4ac-4175-4e45-b171-0a0081e747d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at the White House on Tuesday to sign into law the "Laken Riley Act," aimed at tightening immigration controls.
**[Watch below:](https://substack.com/redirect/b50ae4ac-4175-4e45-b171-0a0081e747d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b50ae4ac-4175-4e45-b171-0a0081e747d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Laken Riley, 22, was killed on the University of Georgia campus last year by a man who was in the country illegally. The act, named in her honor, expands **[the grounds for detaining undocumented immigrants,](https://substack.com/redirect/a196ba7a-a58b-4efa-96f5-eb0eab0bc913?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** specifically those accused of certain crimes, even before they are convicted.
At the signing ceremony, Phillips, visibly emotional, spoke about the impact of her daughter's death. "There is no amount of change that will ever bring back our precious Laken. Our only hope moving forward is that her life saves lives," she said. She also expressed gratitude towards Trump, stating, "We also want to thank President Trump for the promises he made to us. He said he would secure our borders and that he would never forget about Laken, and he hasn't. He's a man of his word."
The Laken Riley Act mandates that ICE detain undocumented immigrants accused of theft, burglary, or shoplifting until their legal proceedings conclude, aiming to prevent similar tragedies. The legislation passed both houses of Congress with bipartisan support, reflecting a rare consensus on immigration policy.
Trump snapped a a reporter who asked an untimely question during the signing, as Riley's mother was standing right behind him.
"Now is not the time for that!" Trump told the reporter. **[Watch the tense moment below:](https://substack.com/redirect/b50ae4ac-4175-4e45-b171-0a0081e747d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
# Stephen Miller HUMILIATES Jake Tapper for claiming illegals are needed for agriculture
White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller **[took a wrecking ball to Jake Tapper](https://substack.com/redirect/59f8d04a-bb9c-4ab1-a882-dbee2b754d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on CNN during a combative interview.
"We are going to unapologetically enforce our immigration laws!!" Miller told Tapper during the clash.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/59f8d04a-bb9c-4ab1-a882-dbee2b754d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tapper, attempting to steer the conversation towards Trump administration policy, questioned Miller about the implications of the immigration crackdown on agriculture.
Miller responded sharply, "I'm sure it's not your position, Jake, you're just asking the question that we should supply America's food with exploitative, illegal alien labor?"
**[Watch the full exchange below:](https://substack.com/redirect/59f8d04a-bb9c-4ab1-a882-dbee2b754d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

subject: What is the “Prepare the Way” revival and how can you help?
body:
So, they created Saving the Easter Bunny, a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=bdfffec7fff74353a49aec8bfce1380b&_e=E1PgeV-h-aIRTeCL5S5wUwyELWNlmmTMyw4PGpuyEWBllcwDtlgVstR-h_aEIUHiMHx1isR_tm8JKbfgpyE22FqUlCUl_5nfsd3GrHhA0qhoG1VZGsC85j7M56JFBDWQnEEAOqBzitRAYGYmyc3Fg2YaLzCHqreFbVeRt0WMqoCm3nLl9L2Q_hMIn78ZdmxMCjCThziN_r4Vw_OKsv-KR53yr5Csmiu2qMc3F75Ae-BULNdFeCJl-hxkpSEvlyMw2lyJP-atZhpKFSYro-ouQuLtXrwb_rBJecH7cka7992vI7JHv6-Ek2UpRYf9Gna0BfYRKfJZehCCSTP9mXVhwPZaJ9K7aZ4ziQCYKl5FHC2pCaUTdz_c-RV6jtuKENQm)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
Just look at what parents have already said about S _aving the Easter Bunny_ :
---
"It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully."
---
— Lisa A.
---
"My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!"
---
– Bob A.
---
"My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts."
---
– Laurin
---
And listen to this...**[**Your "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100 or more, not only helps fund this revival campaign that makes Jesus the reason for the Easter season once more...**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=bdfffec7fff74353a49aec8bfce1380b&_e=E1PgeV-h-aIRTeCL5S5wUwyELWNlmmTMyw4PGpuyEWBllcwDtlgVstR-h_aEIUHiMHx1isR_tm8JKbfgpyE22FqUlCUl_5nfsd3GrHhA0qhoG1VZGsC85j7M56JFBDWQnEEAOqBzitRAYGYmyc3Fg2YaLzCHqreFbVeRt0WMqoCm3nLl9L2Q_hMIn78ZdmxMCjCThziN_r4Vw_OKsv-KR53yr5Csmiu2qMc3F75Ae-Ci1OL8QQcGLyb0hcqywnz9ucs-nSQoF7hH5OmeZJlTh8C1OhoAbFXwyRuy1LSjPS4zSaSomIAYFfsxgS0Y7n1-ipvxaRHhYPK3gcab6dqpt7F114fQB_021Pf36Ua_hTz7HknaxFwX6aqtSMMKgm15)** Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools.AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=bdfffec7fff74353a49aec8bfce1380b&_e=E1PgeV-h-aIRTeCL5S5wUwyELWNlmmTMyw4PGpuyEWBllcwDtlgVstR-h_aEIUHiMHx1isR_tm8JKbfgpyE22FqUlCUl_5nfsd3GrHhA0qhoG1VZGsC85j7M56JFBDWQnEEAOqBzitRAYGYmyc3Fg2YaLzCHqreFbVeRt0WMqoCm3nLl9L2Q_hMIn78ZdmxMCjCThziN_r4Vw_OKsv-KR53yr5Csmiu2qMc3F75Ae-A3L2xunH9L-FK-92vPyYj7DPapP_RgxIJ8gx4qGwATh9eZG0tIlz3tiGjWNSZXq_q-UAbSaaHRopMmJy1gGsJkCD8jlu6mURU875TDQuDGeaWwR6jCgBa2EaVBtf43nJeRNzdmjtYA8--B37OPNuBV)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=bdfffec7fff74353a49aec8bfce1380b&_e=E1PgeV-h-aIRTeCL5S5wUwyELWNlmmTMyw4PGpuyEWBllcwDtlgVstR-h_aEIUHiMHx1isR_tm8JKbfgpyE22FqUlCUl_5nfsd3GrHhA0qhoG1VZGsC85j7M56JFBDWQnEEAOqBzitRAYGYmyc3Fg2YaLzCHqreFbVeRt0WMqoCm3nLl9L2Q_hMIn78ZdmxMCjCThziN_r4Vw_OKsv-KR53yr5Csmiu2qMc3F75Ae-AlOKffxd8MeLR9KEuatbqdhpFf2wlNtA20Ck6MVhyIcB-GQRhln0CaG1SOiaoyM2JE-LVaE0Adz-IH25oggf-0ZzWX6SYnxCdUpynhgEmwpNfV8j53pRxEhJqayf5PfnMmXvCsaHcyzirX4uUzLMOf)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.

After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done: >> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of Saving the Easter Bunny and a 17-city church tour. Just look at what parents have already said about S aving the Easter Bunny : "It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully." — Lisa A. "My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!" – Bob A. "My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts." – Laurin And listen to this... Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools.AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you , Brave Books will send you Saving the Easter Bunny absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep Saving the Easter Bunny for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America. May God bless you this coming Easter season, | | Kirk CameronActor, Author, and Father | | | Kirk CameronActor, Author, and Father | | | P.S. They've launched a massive 12-week "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate -- to Jesus. body:
An update on the federal aid freeze.
#
These last few hours have been a whirlwind — with Trump’s White House making their first major attempt to loot our veterans, healthcare, education, and more.
**First** , the White House released a memo announcing a total freeze on federal aid yesterday. Almost immediately, Medicaid portals in all 50 states stopped working.
**Then** , today news broke that the decision had been rescinded — with even some Republicans celebrating the reversal.
**Now** , the White House is adding even more to the confusion:
Trump and his White House wants to distract and confuse us so we’re divided and left fighting over the scraps. **We cannot let them**.
It's so important that we keep loudly mobilizing against this administration in order to build a mass movement for progress. From his reactionary cabinet appointments to threats towards immigrant Americans and allied countries, President Trump has returned to Washington with a vengeance. What might seem like an overwhelming torrent of outrageous news over the past week will likely continue unabated.
This country is so vicious--and unfortunately, stupid--that it is cutting off its own nose to spite its proverbial face.
While I tend to prefer writing long-form analysis, I'm trying a somewhat different format in this post. Each of the sections below would ideally be its own article, but working multiple jobs has limited how much time I have available to research and write.

### **Immigration**
As an immigrant, [watching Democrats in Congress join Republicans](https://substack.com/redirect/93d7db94-21ae-4a1e-a507-77f983fb7309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to demonize immigrants, and allow arrests based on suspicion--without any proof of wrongdoing--felt revolting. Anyone pretending that Democrats offer a better alternative to the GOP should be ashamed for enabling that ruse to continue.
Beyond the Laken Riley Act (which Trump [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/93d7db94-21ae-4a1e-a507-77f983fb7309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to sign into law today), Trump also issued a series of nearly a dozen executive orders inviting further restrictions on immigrants. We still haven't unwound the [impacts from his previous attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/5711caee-3c2b-419d-9951-09a863487fcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on immigrants.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21de8911-1591-44d0-9a52-9769adb692cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Expect family separations to return.
All this would be bad enough even if America didn't rely on undocumented immigrants for a variety of roles, including hospitality, construction, and particularly, [rebuilding in the wake of natural disasters](https://substack.com/redirect/aa3b4e6f-0a0d-4e74-9827-081854d15b1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) like the recent catastrophic floods in North Carolina or the wildfires that devastated Los Angeles.
This country is so vicious--and unfortunately, stupid--that it is cutting off its own nose to spite its proverbial face.
