### **The origins of COVID, proof of alien life, and why we can 't trust the CIA**
After dismissing people who criticized the military's role in developing the COVID-19 virus and the apparent incompetence of its leak from a supposedly secure lab into the world (where it went on to [kill at least 3 million people](https://substack.com/redirect/e4df2822-c663-4ac5-a61e-65347faa1a84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), the CIA recently reversed course.
Announcing the results of an investigation started under Biden, the CIA this week [concluded](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7c945b-2e7a-4410-b0a6-bf5b0e6f3f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the COVID-19 virus most likely escaped from a lab. Recall that the "lab leak" hypothesis was, for years, officially discredited and treated as disinformation before that hypothesis more recently became an object of consensus.
The arc traces the same pattern as "conspiracies" about the existence of extraterrestrial life, which were derided for decades before a [series of recent congressional hearings](https://substack.com/redirect/31c32dfb-6023-42d6-b6c6-336331655cfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explored the topic transparently for the first time.
It's the same pattern visible in the Agency's false claims about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq, which led to an illegitimate invasion and the death of [at least a million people](https://substack.com/redirect/b9a2c10c-6729-4d81-9bf8-24b9287a5f21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Why does anyone believe anything the CIA says? Not many institutions can plausibly claim a death count numbering in the millions.
### **Someone tell Netanyahu he agreed to a ceasefire**
Earlier this month, I was as excited as anyone upon learning that [a ceasefire had finally been reached](https://substack.com/redirect/3bc520f4-d579-422b-b975-e91ed2cf0a6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between Israel and Hamas. Informed by the preceding pattern, I [predicted](https://substack.com/redirect/11575adc-8b62-4f92-83d6-10136660ddaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the ceasefire would unfortunately prove ineffective, and that the genocide would continue.
I hate being [proven right](https://substack.com/redirect/e2a305ca-79fe-40e0-bcab-965f5401df45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

### **Insider trading and corruption**
A bipartisan block of policymakers recently [introduced](https://substack.com/redirect/3d367905-fc42-4d58-812c-c492c94c2b79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a bill to curtail insider trading by members of Congress.
While important, their proposal could appear in a dictionary next to the phrase "too little too late."
Where were these figures when their outrage could have made a difference? When I ran for Congress against the literal poster child of this problem and [proposed a solution](https://substack.com/redirect/f01e3dcf-ba8c-43e4-96f5-bc452b88d734?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) years ago, they were doing things like [appearing on the covers](https://substack.com/redirect/66a44a85-9caf-4efd-880f-5d9e858b41d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of magazines like Vanity Fair and praising the queen of insider trading even while she [dragged](https://substack.com/redirect/768172b5-f96e-4d08-ba61-95179d2c1ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) them publicly and [marginalized](https://substack.com/redirect/2246604a-ad60-4ef1-85c7-45076669508f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) them within Congress.
When it mattered, the figures [now](https://substack.com/redirect/42af8ec0-a586-4e0a-9199-a50f2302935c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) calling to ban congressional insider trading chose to hold their fire and place their careers before issues that are sadly nothing new.
I hope Congress passes this bill. And I hope voters see through the political theater orchestrated by careerists who lacked the courage to speak out when it mattered.
### **Democrats, gerontocracy, and hypocrisy**
Democrats say [they want new leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/5495b019-3dd2-49ae-a213-0e63aaa6b5dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but they act like a rabid cult dedicated to building careers and dynasties for corrupt oligarchs. [Mine wasn't the only voice](https://substack.com/redirect/b184e508-67e3-407e-9427-0396f1884480?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) neutralized by the Democratic Party's strategic employment of racism to politically insulate the party's commitment to militarism and economic predation.
I've written recently about how the Democratic Party [can't learn](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc44385-df3e-48b3-93dd-97ec7e1773b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lessons from its electoral defeat, particularly [because](https://substack.com/redirect/04816aea-89a6-4b2a-a029-aeea08383c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its most powerful voices have different incentives than the rest of us.
At the same time, [describing the party's problem as rooted in gerontocracy is inaccurate, and also charitable](https://substack.com/redirect/8225363c-d781-4c65-b6a1-7820d9d70009?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since it downplays the extent to which its corruption is institutional, rather than only rooted in the careers of particular individuals.
As long as they defer to the corruption of those party elites, grassroots voices calling for change in the party will remain frustrated.
### **Tik tok and free expression**
When the Supreme Court upheld Congress' expression-killing law to require the sale of TikTok, Americans predictably flocked to other platforms.
While establishment voices claim the TikTok presents national security concerns, the reality is that it was among the few social media platforms to resist government pressure to diminish the visibility of the ongoing genocide in Gaza.
Americans are a lot less free than most of us seem to think. Rarely has that been proven more visibly. At least our supposed adversaries understand: "Chinese people always feel like they live in the only country that has really restricted internet spaces....Now, Americans are experiencing the same with [the TikTok ban], so now we can all relate, [we all have the same struggles and problems](https://substack.com/redirect/441e7e3f-aac7-412f-aa37-48a2a4b90ac0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."

### Tearing the mask off
Is [the world at a historical inflection point](https://substack.com/redirect/78ecd7fa-1d3b-4b8a-bb12-c838f136f6e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as some have suggested? Or are observers finally waking up to smell the proverbial coffee and recognize the imperialism that has long characterized U.S. foreign policy now that the mask has been ripped off?
Trump's belligerence towards countries including Denmark and Panama is so overtly vicious and imperial that he might have exposed America internationally for what it has always been: a murderous, megalomaniacal, narcissistic Empire built on the back of ignorance and violence.
I've been wishing for the past 25 years that the rest of the world would come to see America for what it is: a belligerent imperial engine of mass murder, rather than a city on a hill with a beacon illuminating human rights, as its propagandists have preferred to suggest.
On one hand, America has always tried to overlook the horrors pervading its legacy, from the [indigenous genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/2e3a8421-3345-4f96-93ed-4e86476ae6c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the trans Atlantic slave trade to the denial of rights for women and sexual minorities, and today's [relentless militarism undermining democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/7bbf627a-c138-4edc-baa8-ba05aa50c56f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) around the world.
Having been born in 1974, my particular awareness of America's contemporary failures emerged during the Reagan administration.
It was under the George W. Bush administration that I grew more politically active, and it was then that my awareness of fascism in the United States came to fruition. The invasion and military occupation of foreign countries on false pretenses, a policy of [torture and human experimentation](https://substack.com/redirect/d6554ffd-248a-43b4-8c94-edf47e2b43fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), mass [surveillance](https://substack.com/redirect/6b5e52a1-0d6e-40c4-b837-3edcfb14edce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), pervasive government secrecy, and a profound and enduring refusal to allow accountability for any of this--even under subsequent administrations from theoretically opposed political parties whose leaders had won office by promising accountability--forced me to recognize that America remained more beholden to the worst parts of its legacy than the vision animating songs like the national anthem or "America the Beautiful."
In this context, the return of Donald Trump to the White House may offer promise in an unlikely and ironic way. While the rest of the world has kept its collective had buried in the sand, enabled by the same propagandists in New York, Los Angeles, and DC who routinely mislead the American public on behalf of the military industrial complex that destroyed democracy here a long time ago, that ruse appears to have worn off.
No number of sympathetic reports can hide the brutality of the Trump administration, or the shameless imperialism that has characterized U.S. foreign policy not since his inauguration, but since the end of the Second World War. In other words, Trump's belligerence towards countries including [Denmark](https://substack.com/redirect/354ffe88-44d3-46d5-9083-051394b95f02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Panama](https://substack.com/redirect/c6c76fe5-ccf9-4449-bfba-f04d8235ea3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is so overtly vicious and imperial that he might have exposed America internationally for what it has always been: a murderous, megalomaniacal, narcissistic Empire built on the back of ignorance and violence.
Whatever else happens over the next four years, an early consequence of Trump's return to Washington is the destruction of the goodwill that America earned by waging the Second World War and liberating Europe. If that goodwill allowed Europe to ignore our more recent brutality as we invaded countries from Chile to Vietnam in the name of supposedly making the world safe for democracy, it seems to have finally run out.
Had journalists and international institutions reached the awareness sooner, without requiring such [overt admissions of fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/3cb77aba-0c2c-4227-9232-8280761df166?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in order to recognize it, this moment could have been prevented.
### The price of ignorance
Instead, human rights and climate justice have already become ensnared in a race to the bottom. The intergenerational harm of allowing the climate catastrophe to go undressed today is even more pernicious than the obliviousness of the past 25 years.
Ever since the contest between Al Gore and George Bush in 2000, climate justice has gained increasingly widespread awareness among the American people. Yet, even over that entire generation, it has remained little more than a rhetorical nod in government. While our government sits on his hands, industry continues to relentlessly poison life on this planet.
The only hope for life on Earth to survive, let alone thrive, is for the international epicenter of fascism that DC has come to represent to be dislodged.
Americans might have been forced to recognize the true horrors that our country has always tried to cover up, from [Emmett Till's murder](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e61d79-9804-4f10-aaab-b8786572d04b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the [assassinations](https://substack.com/redirect/38e5153b-7f7b-44cc-9f53-44e9e22026ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of figures like Dr. King and Malcolm X. But, for once, the international community seems to be growing aware of it, too.
It may have been too much to wish that anyone would bother to learn or remember history, but current events will force the reality into the face of even those who have tried to cover their eyes.

From his reactionary cabinet appointments to threats towards immigrant Americans and allied countries, President Trump has returned to Washington with a vengeance. What might seem like an overwhelming torrent of outrageous news over the past week will likely continue unabated.
This country is so vicious--and unfortunately, stupid--that it is cutting off its own nose to spite its proverbial face.
While I tend to prefer writing long-form analysis, I'm trying a somewhat different format in this post. Each of the sections below would ideally be its own article, but working multiple jobs has limited how much time I have available to research and write.

### **Immigration**
As an immigrant, [watching Democrats in Congress join Republicans](https://substack.com/redirect/93d7db94-21ae-4a1e-a507-77f983fb7309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to demonize immigrants, and allow arrests based on suspicion--without any proof of wrongdoing--felt revolting. Anyone pretending that Democrats offer a better alternative to the GOP should be ashamed for enabling that ruse to continue.
Beyond the Laken Riley Act (which Trump [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/93d7db94-21ae-4a1e-a507-77f983fb7309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to sign into law today), Trump also issued a series of nearly a dozen executive orders inviting further restrictions on immigrants. We still haven't unwound the [impacts from his previous attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/5711caee-3c2b-419d-9951-09a863487fcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on immigrants.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21de8911-1591-44d0-9a52-9769adb692cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Expect family separations to return.
All this would be bad enough even if America didn't rely on undocumented immigrants for a variety of roles, including hospitality, construction, and particularly, [rebuilding in the wake of natural disasters](https://substack.com/redirect/aa3b4e6f-0a0d-4e74-9827-081854d15b1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) like the recent catastrophic floods in North Carolina or the wildfires that devastated Los Angeles.
This country is so vicious--and unfortunately, stupid--that it is cutting off its own nose to spite its proverbial face.

### **The origins of COVID, proof of alien life, and why we can 't trust the CIA**
After dismissing people who criticized the military's role in developing the COVID-19 virus and the apparent incompetence of its leak from a supposedly secure lab into the world (where it went on to [kill at least 3 million people](https://substack.com/redirect/e4df2822-c663-4ac5-a61e-65347faa1a84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), the CIA recently reversed course.
Announcing the results of an investigation started under Biden, the CIA this week [concluded](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7c945b-2e7a-4410-b0a6-bf5b0e6f3f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the COVID-19 virus most likely escaped from a lab. Recall that the "lab leak" hypothesis was, for years, officially discredited and treated as disinformation before that hypothesis more recently became an object of consensus.
The arc traces the same pattern as "conspiracies" about the existence of extraterrestrial life, which were derided for decades before a [series of recent congressional hearings](https://substack.com/redirect/31c32dfb-6023-42d6-b6c6-336331655cfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explored the topic transparently for the first time.
It's the same pattern visible in the Agency's false claims about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq, which led to an illegitimate invasion and the death of [at least a million people](https://substack.com/redirect/b9a2c10c-6729-4d81-9bf8-24b9287a5f21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Why does anyone believe anything the CIA says? Not many institutions can plausibly claim a death count numbering in the millions.
### **Someone tell Netanyahu he agreed to a ceasefire**
Earlier this month, I was as excited as anyone upon learning that [a ceasefire had finally been reached](https://substack.com/redirect/3bc520f4-d579-422b-b975-e91ed2cf0a6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between Israel and Hamas. Informed by the preceding pattern, I [predicted](https://substack.com/redirect/11575adc-8b62-4f92-83d6-10136660ddaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the ceasefire would unfortunately prove ineffective, and that the genocide would continue.
I hate being [proven right](https://substack.com/redirect/e2a305ca-79fe-40e0-bcab-965f5401df45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

### **Insider trading and corruption**
A bipartisan block of policymakers recently [introduced](https://substack.com/redirect/3d367905-fc42-4d58-812c-c492c94c2b79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a bill to curtail insider trading by members of Congress.
While important, their proposal could appear in a dictionary next to the phrase "too little too late."
Where were these figures when their outrage could have made a difference? When I ran for Congress against the literal poster child of this problem and [proposed a solution](https://substack.com/redirect/f01e3dcf-ba8c-43e4-96f5-bc452b88d734?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) years ago, they were doing things like [appearing on the covers](https://substack.com/redirect/66a44a85-9caf-4efd-880f-5d9e858b41d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of magazines like Vanity Fair and praising the queen of insider trading even while she [dragged](https://substack.com/redirect/768172b5-f96e-4d08-ba61-95179d2c1ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) them publicly and [marginalized](https://substack.com/redirect/2246604a-ad60-4ef1-85c7-45076669508f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) them within Congress.
When it mattered, the figures [now](https://substack.com/redirect/42af8ec0-a586-4e0a-9199-a50f2302935c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) calling to ban congressional insider trading chose to hold their fire and place their careers before issues that are sadly nothing new.
I hope Congress passes this bill. And I hope voters see through the political theater orchestrated by careerists who lacked the courage to speak out when it mattered.
### **Democrats, gerontocracy, and hypocrisy**
Democrats say [they want new leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/5495b019-3dd2-49ae-a213-0e63aaa6b5dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but they act like a rabid cult dedicated to building careers and dynasties for corrupt oligarchs. [Mine wasn't the only voice](https://substack.com/redirect/b184e508-67e3-407e-9427-0396f1884480?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) neutralized by the Democratic Party's strategic employment of racism to politically insulate the party's commitment to militarism and economic predation.
I've written recently about how the Democratic Party [can't learn](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc44385-df3e-48b3-93dd-97ec7e1773b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lessons from its electoral defeat, particularly [because](https://substack.com/redirect/04816aea-89a6-4b2a-a029-aeea08383c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its most powerful voices have different incentives than the rest of us.
At the same time, [describing the party's problem as rooted in gerontocracy is inaccurate, and also charitable](https://substack.com/redirect/8225363c-d781-4c65-b6a1-7820d9d70009?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since it downplays the extent to which its corruption is institutional, rather than only rooted in the careers of particular individuals.
As long as they defer to the corruption of those party elites, grassroots voices calling for change in the party will remain frustrated.
### **Tik tok and free expression**
When the Supreme Court upheld Congress' expression-killing law to require the sale of TikTok, Americans predictably flocked to other platforms.
While establishment voices claim the TikTok presents national security concerns, the reality is that it was among the few social media platforms to resist government pressure to diminish the visibility of the ongoing genocide in Gaza.
Americans are a lot less free than most of us seem to think. Rarely has that been proven more visibly. At least our supposed adversaries understand: "Chinese people always feel like they live in the only country that has really restricted internet spaces....Now, Americans are experiencing the same with [the TikTok ban], so now we can all relate, [we all have the same struggles and problems](https://substack.com/redirect/441e7e3f-aac7-412f-aa37-48a2a4b90ac0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."

When I think about why I started JanePAC, it always comes back to people like you. It’s not the flashy headlines or the politicians in Washington that give me hope for the future. It’s the conversations I’ve had with grassroots activists in communities across this country — **ordinary people doing extraordinary things to fight for climate progress.** That’s why we built this PAC. To give supporters like you a real seat at the table in the fight against Big Oil and the politicians they bankroll. And together, we’re accomplishing incredible things. This month, we scored two major special election victories for 2025. **In Virginia** , we helped keep the state Senate out of Republican hands. And last night **in Minnesota** , we broke a 33-33 tie, flipping the Senate back to Democratic control and blocking Trump’s allies from steamrolling their anti-climate agenda. clean_body: Join my Grassroots Cabinet and help us take on Big Oil. | When I think about why I started JanePAC, it always comes back to people like you. It’s not the flashy headlines or the politicians in Washington that give me hope for the future. It’s the conversations I’ve had with grassroots activists in communities across this country — ordinary people doing extraordinary things to fight for climate progress. That’s why we built this PAC. To give supporters like you a real seat at the table in the fight against Big Oil and the politicians they bankroll. And together, we’re accomplishing incredible things. In 2024 alone, we elected nearly 100 climate champions to critical down-ballot races around the country — leaders who are fighting to protect their communities from Trump and Big Oil’s destructive federal agenda. This month, we scored two major special election victories for 2025. In Virginia , we helped keep the state Senate out of Republican hands. And last night in Minnesota , we broke a 33-33 tie, flipping the Senate back to Democratic control and blocking Trump’s allies from steamrolling their anti-climate agenda. And we’re just getting started. This year, there are over 100,000 open seats on the ballot. That’s more seats than in 2024, and every single one of them is an opportunity to fight for bold climate solutions — if we have the resources to meet the moment. That’s why sustained monthly support is so important. Grassroots donors like you allow us to plan ahead, respond quickly to attacks from Big Oil, and invest in the leaders who will drive bold climate solutions. I’m inviting you to join Jane’s Grassroots Cabinet, a new program that brings together the passionate supporters who power this movement. = | = As a member, you’ll receive: ✅ Exclusive updates directly from me about the progress your investment is making possible ✅ Early and discounted access to JanePAC events and merchandise ✅ Invitations to special events with me throughout the year And because I truly value your support, I personally call a few of our recurring donors each month to say thank you. You just might be one of the lucky ones to get a ring from me. This work has never been more urgent. Trump’s return to the White House and his alliance with the fossil fuel giants threaten to undo all of the progress we’ve made. We can’t afford to lose ground now — not when we’ve already proven that grassroots power can win, over and over again. If you’ve ever wondered how you can have a direct impact on the climate movement, this is your chance. Your $10 monthly commitment will fuel the fight for climate progress and connect you to the movement that’s reshaping what’s possible. = = Let’s do this, xx Jane P.S. We know not everyone is in a position to commit to a monthly donation. Whether you can contribute or not, we’re beyond grateful to have you on our team. We will have more info soon on how you can join my Grassroots Cabinet by volunteering for our 2025 campaigns! | Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2235%2E135344%2EJPEhPY)

Friend --
Amidst all the political news of the last few days, I wanted to reflect on the announcement that my friend Gary Peters -- now Michigan’s senior senator -- won’t seek re-election next year.
Gary is a public servant in every sense of the word. He’s a veteran, who served overseas as a member of the US Navy Reserve, and has been a champion for Michigan’s servicemembers in the US Senate.
As Chairman and Ranking Member on the Homeland Security Committee, and on the Armed Services Committee, he has cemented the critical role of the Northern Border Mission Center at Selfridge Air National Guard Base, ensuring that Michigan has an important and enduring role to play in our country’s national security.
In short, Gary is a true Michigander, with a no-nonsense, get-stuff-done attitude, not to mention a real passion for his Harley-Davidson.
On a personal note, Gary has also been an incredible mentor and partner to me. He was tireless on the campaign trail in 2024, both as chair of the national Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee and here in Michigan -- where he and his intrepid wife Colleen even joined me and Senator Debbie Stabenow on our campaign RV for a day of events.
And since I was elected, Gary has gone out of his way to welcome me to the Senate, show me the ropes, and get my office up and running.
I’ve only been here for a short time, but I can already see that Gary and Colleen, who is a force in her own right, will both be greatly missed around here.
But as Gary himself said, he’s not going anywhere over these next two years, and I’m looking forward to working together with him to deliver for Michigan.
Elissa
* * *
